title.raw: 卷9 肅宗紀 Volume 9 Annals: Suzong (Emperor Xiaoming)

sentences.zh: 肅宗孝明皇帝，諱詡，世宗宣武皇帝之第二子，母曰胡充華。

translations.literal: Suzong, Emperor Xiaoming, bore the taboo name Xu; he was Shizong, Emperor Xuanwu's second son; his mother was Hu Chuhua.
translations.idiomatic: Suzong, Emperor Xiaoming, bore the taboo name Xu. He was Shizong, Emperor Xuanwu's second son; his mother was Hu Chuhua.

sentences.zh: 永平三年三月丙戌，帝生于宣光殿之東北，有光照于庭中。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongping, third month, day bingxu, the Emperor was born northeast of the Xuanguang Hall; light shone in the courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yongping, in the third month, on the bingxu day, the emperor was born northeast of the Xuanguang Hall; light shone in the courtyard.

sentences.zh: 延昌元年十月乙亥，立為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the first year of Yanchang, day yihai, he was installed as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the first year of Yanchang, on the yihai day, he was installed as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月丁巳夜，即皇帝位。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, first month of spring, on the night of day dingsi, he took the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, in the first month of spring, on the night of the dingsi day, he took the imperial throne.

sentences.zh: 戊午，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 己未，徵下西討東防諸軍。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: the armies of the western campaign and eastern defense were recalled.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day the armies of the western campaign and eastern defense were recalled.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔太保、高陽王雍入居西栢堂，決庶政，又詔任城王澄為尚書令，百官總己以聽於二王。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: an edict ordered Grand Guardian, Prince of Gaoyang Yong to enter the Western Cypress Hall and decide routine government; it also ordered Prince of Rencheng Cheng to be Minister Director and all officials to entrust themselves to the two princes.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day an edict ordered Yong, grand guardian and Prince of Gaoyang, to enter the Western Cypress Hall and decide routine government; it also ordered Cheng, Prince of Rencheng, to be minister director, and all officials to entrust themselves to the two princes.

sentences.zh: 己巳，勿吉、達槃、地豆和、尼步伽、拔但、佐越費實等諸國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Wuji, Dapan, Didouhe, Nibujia, Baidan, Zuoyue Feishi, and other states sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day Wuji, Dapan, Didouhe, Nibujia, Baidan, Zuoyue Feishi, and other states sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 二月庚辰，尊皇后高氏為皇太后。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengchen: the empress of the Gao clan was honored as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the gengchen day, the empress of the Gao clan was honored as empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，司徒高肇至京師，以罪賜死。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Minister over the Masses Gao Zhao arrived at the capital and was ordered to die for his crime.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day Gao Zhao, minister over the masses, arrived at the capital and was ordered to die for his crime.

sentences.zh: 蕭衍寧州剌史任太洪率眾寇關城，益州長史成興孫擊破之。

translations.literal: Xiao Yan's Inspector of Ningzhou Ren Taihong led a host to raid Guancheng; Chief Clerk of Yizhou Cheng Xingsun defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Taihong, Xiao Yan's inspector of Ningzhou, led a host to raid Guancheng; Cheng Xingsun, chief clerk of Yizhou, defeated him.

sentences.zh: 癸未，太保、高陽王雍進位太傅、領太尉，司空、清河王懌為司徒，驃騎大將軍、廣平王懷為司空。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: Grand Guardian, Prince of Gaoyang Yong was promoted to Grand Tutor and held additionally the post of Grand Minister; Minister of Works, Prince of Qinghe Yi was made Minister over the Masses; Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Prince of Guangping Huai was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day Yong, grand guardian and Prince of Gaoyang, was promoted to grand tutor and held additionally the post of grand minister; Yi, minister of works and Prince of Qinghe, was made minister over the masses; Huai, grand general of agile cavalry and Prince of Guanghe, was made minister of works.

sentences.zh: 己亥，尊胡充華為皇太妃。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Hu Chuhua was honored as imperial noble consort.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day Hu Chuhua was honored as imperial noble consort.

sentences.zh: 宕昌國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Dangchang sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Dangchang sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰朔，皇太后出俗為尼，徙御金墉。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiachen, new moon: the empress dowager left the laity and became a nun, moving her residence to the Jintong quarter.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the jiachen day, the new moon, the empress dowager left the laity and became a nun, moving her residence to the Jintong quarter.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔進宮臣位一級。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: an edict ordered palace officials promoted one rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day an edict ordered palace officials promoted one rank.

sentences.zh: 先是，蕭衍於浮山堰淮，規為揚徐之害，詔平南將軍楊大眼討之。

translations.literal: Earlier, Xiao Yan had dammed the Huai at Fushan, intending harm to Yang and Xu; an edict ordered General Who Pacifies the South Yang Dayan to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Xiao Yan had dammed the Huai at Fushan, intending harm to Yang and Xu; an edict ordered Yang Dayan, general who pacifies the south, to attack him.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，進文武羣官位一級。

translations.literal: Day yichou: civil and military officials were promoted one rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day civil and military officials were promoted one rank.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，梁州刺史薛懷古破反氐於沮水。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer: Inspector of Liangzhou Xue Huaigu defeated rebellious Di at the Ju River.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer Xue Huaigu, inspector of Liangzhou, defeated rebellious Di at the Ju River.

sentences.zh: 五月甲寅，南秦州刺史崔暹擊破氐賊，解武興圍。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiayin: Inspector of South Qinzhou Cui Xian defeated Di bandits and lifted the siege of Wuxing.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jiayin day, Cui Xian, inspector of South Qinzhou, defeated Di bandits and lifted the siege of Wuxing.

sentences.zh: 六月，沙門法慶聚眾反於冀州，殺阜城令，自稱大乘。

translations.literal: Sixth month: the monk Fajing gathered a crowd and rebelled in Jizhou, killed the magistrate of Fucheng, and styled himself Mahayana.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the monk Fajing gathered a crowd and rebelled in Jizhou, killed the magistrate of Fucheng, and styled himself Mahayana.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸卯，蠕蠕國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day guimao: Rouran sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the guimao day, Rouran sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔假右光祿大夫元遙征北大將軍，攻討法慶。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: an edict made Acting Right Honorable Grand Master Yuan Yao General Who Campaigns North and attack Fajing.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day an edict made Yuan Yao, acting right honorable grand master, general who campaigns north to attack Fajing.

sentences.zh: 宕昌國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Dangchang sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Dangchang sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 八月乙亥，領軍于忠矯詔殺左僕射郭祚、尚書裴植，免太傅、領太尉、高陽王雍官，以王還第。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yihai: Director of the Palace Guard Yu Zhong forged an edict and killed Left Vice Director Guo Zuo and Minister Pei Zhi; he removed Grand Tutor, Grand Minister, Prince of Gaoyang Yong from office and sent the prince home.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the yihai day, Yu Zhong, director of the palace guard, forged an edict and killed Guo Zuo, left vice director, and Pei Zhi, minister; he removed Yong, grand tutor, grand minister, and Prince of Gaoyang, from office and sent the prince home.

sentences.zh: 丙子，尊皇太妃為皇太后。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: the imperial noble consort was honored as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day the imperial noble consort was honored as empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 己卯，吐谷渾國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，蕭衍定州刺史田超秀率眾三千請降。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Xiao Yan's Inspector of Dingzhou Tian Chaoqiu led three thousand men to request surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day Tian Chaoqiu, Xiao Yan's inspector of Dingzhou, led three thousand men to request surrender.

sentences.zh: 戊子，帝朝皇太后於宣光殿，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: the emperor attended upon the empress dowager at the Xuanguang Hall and proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day the emperor attended upon the empress dowager at the Xuanguang Hall and proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 己丑，司徒、清河王懌進位太傅，領太尉；

translations.literal: Day jichou: Minister over the Masses, Prince of Qinghe Yi was promoted to Grand Tutor and held additionally the post of Grand Minister;
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day Yi, minister over the masses and Prince of Qinghe, was promoted to grand tutor and held additionally the post of grand minister;

sentences.zh: 司空、廣平王懷為太保，領司徒；

translations.literal: Minister of Works, Prince of Guangping Huai was made Grand Guardian and held additionally the post of Minister over the Masses;
translations.idiomatic: Huai, minister of works and Prince of Guangping, was made grand guardian and held additionally the post of minister over the masses;

sentences.zh: 驃騎大將軍、任城王澄為司空。

translations.literal: Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Prince of Rencheng Cheng was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng, grand general of agile cavalry and Prince of Rencheng, was made minister of works.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，車騎大將軍于忠為尚書令，特進崔光為車騎大將軍，並儀同三司。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry Yu Zhong was made Minister Director; Special Advanced Cui Guang was made Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry; both held equal precedence with the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day Yu Zhong was made minister director; Cui Guang, special advanced, was made grand general of chariots and cavalry; both held equal precedence with the three excellencies.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，復前江陽王繼本國；

translations.literal: Day renchen: the former Prince of Jiangyang Ji was restored to his original state;
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day the former Prince of Jiangyang Ji was restored to his original state;

sentences.zh: 以濟南王彧復先封，為臨淮王。

translations.literal: Prince of Jinan Yu was restored to his former enfeoffment as Prince of Linhuai.
translations.idiomatic: Yu, Prince of Jinan, was restored to his former enfeoffment as Prince of Linhuai.

sentences.zh: 羣臣奏請皇太后臨朝稱制。

translations.literal: The ministers memorialized requesting that the empress dowager hold court and exercise regency.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers memorialized requesting that the empress dowager hold court and exercise regency.

sentences.zh: 九月乙巳，皇太后親覽萬機，詔曰：「高祖革禮成治，遺澤在民。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yisi: the empress dowager personally handled affairs of state; an edict said, "Gaozu reformed rites and completed governance; his lingering bounty rests on the people.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the yisi day, the empress dowager personally handled affairs of state; an edict said, "Gaozu reformed rites and completed governance; his lingering bounty rests on the people.

sentences.zh: 世宗纂承丕業，聖德昭達。

translations.literal: Shizong succeeded the great enterprise; his sage virtue shone far.
translations.idiomatic: Shizong succeeded the great enterprise; his sage virtue shone far.

sentences.zh: 朕以沖孺，屬當寶圖，洪基至重，若履冰薄。

translations.literal: We, being young and tender, have been set upon the imperial chart; the great foundation is weighty indeed, as if treading on thin ice.
translations.idiomatic: We, being young and tender, have been set upon the imperial chart; the great foundation is weighty indeed, as if treading on thin ice.

sentences.zh: 王公百辟羣牧庶官，皆受遇先朝，寵榮自昔，宜各勉崇，共康世道，勠力竭誠，以匡輔不逮。

translations.literal: Kings, dukes, the hundred ministers, provincial governors, and all officials have all received favor from the former court; glory and honor are of old—each should strive to exalt virtue, together to secure the age, and with united strength and utmost loyalty assist where we fall short.
translations.idiomatic: Kings, dukes, the hundred ministers, provincial governors, and all officials have all received favor from the former court; glory and honor are of old—each should strive to exalt virtue, together to secure the age, and with united strength and utmost loyalty assist where we fall short.

sentences.zh: 其有懷道丘園、昧跡板築、山栖谷飲、舒卷從時者，宜廣戔帛，緝和鼎餁。

translations.literal: Those who cherish the Way in garden and grove, hide their tracks at the pounding frame, dwell in mountains and drink in valleys, and unfold or withdraw as the times require should be given ample silks to harmonize the tripod's stew.
translations.idiomatic: Those who cherish the Way in garden and grove, hide their tracks at the pounding frame, dwell in mountains and drink in valleys, and unfold or withdraw as the times require should be given ample silks to harmonize the tripod's stew.

sentences.zh: 有能讜言直諫、濟世益時者，在所以聞，當待以不次之位。

translations.literal: Those able to offer forthright counsel and benefit the age should be reported from their districts and will be appointed to extraordinary rank.
translations.idiomatic: Those able to offer forthright counsel and benefit the age should be reported from their districts and will be appointed to extraordinary rank.

sentences.zh: 孝子、順孫、義夫、節婦，表其門閭，以彰厥美。

translations.literal: Filial sons, obedient grandsons, righteous husbands, and chaste wives should have their gates marked to display their excellence.
translations.idiomatic: Filial sons, obedient grandsons, righteous husbands, and chaste wives should have their gates marked to display their excellence.

sentences.zh: 高年孤獨不能自存者，贍以粟帛。

translations.literal: The aged and solitary who cannot support themselves should be provided grain and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: The aged and solitary who cannot support themselves should be provided grain and cloth.

sentences.zh: 若因饑失業、天屬流離，或賣鬻男女以為僕隸者，各聽歸還。

translations.literal: If because of famine they lost their livelihood and kin were scattered, or if men and women were sold as slaves, each may be allowed to return.
translations.idiomatic: If because of famine they lost their livelihood and kin were scattered, or if men and women were sold as slaves, each may be allowed to return.

sentences.zh: 比冀方未肅，徐城寇擾，將統久勞，士卒疲弊，並遣撫慰，賜以衣馬。

translations.literal: Recently the Ji region was not yet pacified and Xucheng suffered raids; the commanders have long been toiling and the soldiers weary—envoys should be sent to comfort them and grant clothing and horses.
translations.idiomatic: Recently the Ji region was not yet pacified and Xucheng suffered raids; the commanders have long been toiling and the soldiers weary—envoys should be sent to comfort them and grant clothing and horses.

sentences.zh: 緣邊州鎮，固捍之勞，朔方酋庶，北面所委，亦令勞賚，以副其心。

translations.literal: Border provinces and garrisons bear the labor of solid defense; chiefs and people of the northern frontier are entrusted to the north—let them also be rewarded with labor gifts to satisfy their hearts.
translations.idiomatic: Border provinces and garrisons bear the labor of solid defense; chiefs and people of the northern frontier are entrusted to the north—let them also be rewarded with labor gifts to satisfy their hearts.

sentences.zh: 其有先朝舊事寢而不舉、頃來便習不依軌式者，並可疏聞，當加覽裁。

translations.literal: Where former-court matters have lain dormant and recent custom does not follow the standard pattern, all may be reported in summary for our review.
translations.idiomatic: Where former-court matters have lain dormant and recent custom does not follow the standard pattern, all may be reported in summary for our review.

sentences.zh: 若益時利治、不拘常制者，自依別例。

translations.literal: If something benefits the age and governance and is not bound by regular statutes, it shall follow a separate precedent.
translations.idiomatic: If something benefits the age and governance and is not bound by regular statutes, it shall follow a separate precedent.

sentences.zh: 其明相申約，稱朕意焉。」

translations.literal: Make this clearly understood and in accord with our intent."
translations.idiomatic: Make this clearly understood and in accord with our intent."

sentences.zh: 甲寅，征北元遙破斬法慶及渠帥百餘人，傳首京師。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Campaign North Yuan Yao defeated and beheaded Fajing and more than a hundred chieftains; their heads were sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day Yuan Yao, who campaigns north, defeated and beheaded Fajing and more than a hundred chieftains; their heads were sent to the capital.

sentences.zh: 安定王爕薨。

translations.literal: Prince of Anding Ye died.
translations.idiomatic: Ye, Prince of Anding, died.

sentences.zh: 庚申，高昌、庫莫奚、契丹諸國並遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Gaochang, Kumo Xi, and Khitan all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day Gaochang, Kumo Xi, and Khitan all sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 蕭衍將趙祖悅襲據硤石。

translations.literal: Xiao Yan's general Zhao Zuyue seized and held Xiashi by surprise.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yan's general Zhao Zuyue seized and held Xiashi by surprise.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔定州刺史崔亮假鎮南將軍，率諸將討之；

translations.literal: Day guihai: an edict made Inspector of Dingzhou Cui Liang acting General Who Pacifies the South and lead the generals to attack;
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day an edict made Cui Liang, inspector of Dingzhou, acting general who pacifies the south and lead the generals to attack;

sentences.zh: 冀州刺史蕭寶夤為鎮東將軍，次淮堰。

translations.literal: Inspector of Jizhou Xiao Baoyin was made General Who Pacifies the East and encamped at the Huai dam.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Baoyin, inspector of Jizhou, was made general who pacifies the east and encamped at the Huai dam.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，鄧至國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Dengzhi sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day Dengzhi sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚午朔，勿吉國貢楛矢。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day gengwu, new moon: Wuji presented tribute arrows.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the gengwu day, the new moon, Wuji presented tribute arrows.

sentences.zh: 壬午，高麗、吐谷渾國並遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Goryeo and Tuyuhun both sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day Goryeo and Tuyuhun both sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以安定公胡國珍為中書監、儀同三司。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Duke of Anding Hu Guozhen was made Director of the Secretariat and held equal precedence with the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day Hu Guozhen, Duke of Anding, was made director of the secretariat and held equal precedence with the three excellencies.

sentences.zh: 甲午，蕭衍弘化太守杜桂舉郡內屬。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Xiao Yan's Administrator of Honghua Du Gui surrendered his commandery inward.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day Du Gui, Xiao Yan's administrator of Honghua, surrendered his commandery inward.

sentences.zh: 十有二月辛丑，以高陽王雍為太師。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinchou: Prince of Gaoyang Yong was made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the xinchou day, Yong, Prince of Gaoyang, was made grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 己酉，鎮南崔亮破祖悅，遂圍硤石。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Cui Liang, who pacifies the south, defeated Zuyue and then besieged Xiashi.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day Cui Liang, who pacifies the south, defeated Zuyue and then besieged Xiashi.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，帝、皇太后謁景陵。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: the emperor and empress dowager visited Jingling.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day the emperor and empress dowager visited Jingling.

sentences.zh: 高車國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: The Gaoche state sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The Gaoche state sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 熙平元年春正月戊辰朔，大赦，改年。

translations.literal: First month of spring in the first year of Xiping, day wuchen, new moon: a general amnesty; the reign title was changed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the first year of Xiping, on the wuchen day, the new moon, a general amnesty was proclaimed; the reign title was changed.

sentences.zh: 荊沔都督元志大破蕭衍軍，斬其恒農太守王世定等。

translations.literal: Area Commander of Jing and Mian Yuan Zhi greatly defeated Xiao Yan's army and beheaded his Administrator of Hengnong Wang Shiding and others.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Zhi, area commander of Jing and Mian, greatly defeated Xiao Yan's army and beheaded Wang Shiding, his administrator of Hengnong, and others.

sentences.zh: 以吏部尚書李平為鎮軍大將軍兼尚書右僕射，為行臺，節度討硤石諸軍。

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel Li Ping was made General Who Pacifies the Army and concurrently Right Vice Director; he was made Mobile Headquarters to direct the armies attacking Xiashi.
translations.idiomatic: Li Ping, minister of personnel, was made general who pacifies the army and concurrently right vice director; he was made mobile headquarters to direct the armies attacking Xiashi.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，鎮東蕭寶夤大破衍將於淮北。

translations.literal: Second month, day yisi: Xiao Baoyin, who pacifies the east, greatly defeated Yan's generals north of the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the yisi day, Xiao Baoyin, who pacifies the east, greatly defeated Yan's generals north of the Huai.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，初聽秀才對策，第居中上已上，敍之。

translations.literal: Day guihai: for the first time licentiates were examined by policy essays; those ranked middle upper and above were given office.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, for the first time licentiates were examined by policy essays; those ranked middle upper and above were given office.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，鎮南崔亮、鎮軍李平等克硤石，斬衍豫州刺史趙祖悅，傳首京師，盡俘其眾。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Cui Liang, who pacifies the south, Li Ping, who pacifies the army, and others took Xiashi, beheaded Xiao Yan's Inspector of Yuzhou Zhao Zuyue, sent his head to the capital, and captured all his followers.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day Cui Liang, who pacifies the south, Li Ping, who pacifies the army, and others took Xiashi, beheaded Zhao Zuyue, Xiao Yan's inspector of Yuzhou, sent his head to the capital, and captured all his followers.

sentences.zh: 是月，吐谷渾、宕昌、鄧至諸國並遣朝貢。

translations.literal: That month Tuyuhun, Dangchang, and Dengzhi all sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That month Tuyuhun, Dangchang, and Dengzhi all sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未，以揚州刺史李崇為驃騎將軍、儀同三司。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinwei: Inspector of Yangzhou Li Chong was made Grand General of Agile Cavalry and held equal precedence with the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the xinwei day, Li Chong, inspector of Yangzhou, was made grand general of agile cavalry and held equal precedence with the three excellencies.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以硤石俘虜分賜百僚。

translations.literal: Day renchen: captives from Xiashi were distributed among the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day captives from Xiashi were distributed among the hundred officials.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊戌，以瀛州民饑，開倉賑恤。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, day wuxu: because the people of Yingzhou were famished, granaries were opened to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the wuxu day, because the people of Yingzhou were famished, granaries were opened to relieve them.

sentences.zh: 高昌、陰平國並遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Gaochang and Yinping both sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Gaochang and Yinping both sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 五月丁卯朔，詔曰：「炎旱積辰，苗稼萎悴，比雖微澍，猶未霑洽，晚種不納，企望憂勞，在予之責，思自兢厲。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingmao, new moon: an edict said, "Heat and drought have lasted many days; the crops wither; though there has been slight rain, it has not yet soaked through; late plantings are not in; we look up in anxious toil—the blame rests on us, and we think to discipline ourselves.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the dingmao day, the new moon, an edict said, "Heat and drought have lasted many days; the crops wither; though there has been slight rain, it has not yet soaked through; late plantings are not in; we look up in anxious toil—the blame rests on us, and we think to discipline ourselves.

sentences.zh: 尚書可釐恤獄犴，察其淹枉，簡量輕重，隨事以聞，無使一人怨嗟，增傷和氣。

translations.literal: The Secretariat should examine and comfort those in prison, investigate wrongful detention, weigh severity and lightness, and report as matters arise, so that not one person groans in resentment and harmony is further harmed.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat should examine and comfort those in prison, investigate wrongful detention, weigh severity and lightness, and report as matters arise, so that not one person groans in resentment and harmony is further harmed.

sentences.zh: 土木作役，權皆休罷，勸農省務，肆力田疇。

translations.literal: Earth and timber projects are for the time all halted; encourage farming and reduce affairs; exert strength in the fields.
translations.idiomatic: Earth and timber projects are for the time all halted; encourage farming and reduce affairs; exert strength in the fields.

sentences.zh: 庶嘉澤近降，豐年可必。

translations.literal: May the good rains soon descend and an abundant year be assured."
translations.idiomatic: May the good rains soon descend and an abundant year be assured."

sentences.zh: 」蕭衍衡州刺史張齊寇益州，[1]復以傅豎眼為刺史以討之，頻破賊軍，斬其將任太洪首。

translations.literal: " Xiao Yan's Inspector of Hengzhou Zhang Qi raided Yizhou, [1] and Fu Shuyan was again made inspector to attack him; he repeatedly defeated the rebel armies and beheaded their general Ren Taihong.
translations.idiomatic: " Xiao Yan's inspector of Hengzhou Zhang Qi raided Yizhou, [1] and Fu Shuyan was again made inspector to attack him; he repeatedly defeated the rebel armies and beheaded their general Ren Taihong.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔放華林野獸於山澤。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: an edict released the wild beasts of Hualin Park to mountains and marshes.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day an edict released the wild beasts of Hualin Park to mountains and marshes.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，吐谷渾遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，重申殺牛之禁。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day gengwu: the prohibition on slaughtering cattle was reaffirmed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the gengwu day, the prohibition on slaughtering cattle was reaffirmed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔兵士征硤石者復租賦一年。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: an edict granted soldiers who had campaigned at Xiashi one year's remission of tax and corvée.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day an edict granted soldiers who had campaigned at Xiashi one year's remission of tax and corvée.

sentences.zh: 傅竪眼大破張齊，齊遁走。

translations.literal: Fu Shuyan greatly defeated Zhang Qi; Qi fled.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Shuyan greatly defeated Zhang Qi; Qi fled.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，高昌國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Gaochang sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day Gaochang sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 八月乙巳，以侍中、中書監、儀同三司、安定郡開國公胡國珍為都督雍涇岐華東秦豳六州諸軍事、驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、雍州刺史。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yisi: Attendant at the Secretariat, Director of the Secretariat, Equal in Rank with the Three Excellencies, Duke of Anding Commandery Hu Guozhen was made Area Commander of Yong, Jing, Qi, Hua, East Qin, and Bin—six provinces—Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Commissioner with the Golden Axe, and Inspector of Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the yisi day, Hu Guozhen, attendant at the secretariat, director of the secretariat, equal in rank with the three excellencies, and Duke of Anding commandery, was made area commander of Yong, Jing, Qi, Hua, East Qin, and Bin—six provinces—grand general of agile cavalry, commissioner with the golden axe, and inspector of Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔曰：「先賢列聖，道冠生民，仁風盛德，煥乎圖史。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: an edict said, "Former sages and successive holy ones— their Way crowns living men; benevolent winds and flourishing virtue shine in the histories.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day an edict said, "Former sages and successive holy ones—their Way crowns living men; benevolent winds and flourishing virtue shine in the histories.

sentences.zh: 暨曆數永終，迹隨物變，陵𡑞沓藹，鞠為茂草，古帝諸陵，多見踐藉。

translations.literal: When the mandate's term ended forever, traces followed things in change; tombs piled in mist, turned to rank grass; ancient emperors' mausolea were often trampled.
translations.idiomatic: When the mandate's term ended forever, traces followed things in change; tombs piled in mist, turned to rank grass; ancient emperors' mausolea were often trampled.

sentences.zh: 可明敕所在，諸有帝王墳陵，四面各五十步勿聽耕稼。

translations.literal: Let it be clearly ordered in every place that for all imperial tombs, within fifty paces on each side, farming is not permitted."
translations.idiomatic: Let it be clearly ordered in every place that for all imperial tombs, within fifty paces on each side, farming is not permitted."

sentences.zh: 」宕昌國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Dangchang sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Dangchang sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 九月丁丑，淮堰破，蕭衍緣淮城戍村落十餘萬口，皆漂入于海。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingchou: the Huai dam broke; more than a hundred thousand mouths in Xiao Yan's garrison towns and villages along the Huai were all swept into the sea.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the dingchou day, the Huai dam broke; more than a hundred thousand mouths in Xiao Yan's garrison towns and villages along the Huai were all swept into the sea.

sentences.zh: 十有二月癸巳，詔洛陽、河陰及諸曹雜人年七十已上、鰥寡貧困不能自存，及年雖少而痼疾長廢、窮苦不濟者，研實具列以聞。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guisi: an edict ordered that in Luoyang, Heyin, and among miscellaneous persons of various offices—those seventy and above, widowers and widows in poverty unable to support themselves, and though young yet chronically ill and long disabled or destitute and unable to get by—should be investigated in truth and listed in full for report.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the guisi day, an edict ordered that in Luoyang, Heyin, and among miscellaneous persons of various offices—those seventy and above, widowers and widows in poverty unable to support themselves, and though young yet chronically ill and long disabled or destitute and unable to get by—should be investigated in truth and listed in full for report.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲午，高麗、波斯、疏勒、嚈噠諸國並遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, day jiawu: Goryeo, Persia, Shule, and Yanda all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jiawu day, Goryeo, Persia, Shule, and Yanda all sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔京尹所統，百年以上賜大郡板，九十以上賜小郡板。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: an edict ordered that within the capital prefect's jurisdiction, those a hundred and above were granted a great commandery staff, those ninety and above a small commandery staff.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day an edict ordered that within the capital prefect's jurisdiction, those a hundred and above were granted a great commandery staff, those ninety and above a small commandery staff.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以中書監、開府儀同三司胡國珍為司徒公，特進、汝南王悅為中書監、儀同三司。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Director of the Secretariat, Commissioner with the Golden Axe Hu Guozhen was made Minister of Works; Special Advanced, Prince of Runan Yue was made Director of the Secretariat and held equal precedence with the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day Hu Guozhen, director of the secretariat and commissioner with the golden axe, was made minister of works; Yue, special advanced and Prince of Runan, was made director of the secretariat and held equal precedence with the three excellencies.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，皇太后幸伊闕石窟寺，即日還宮。

translations.literal: Day yimao: the empress dowager visited the Yique cave temple and returned to the palace the same day.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day the empress dowager visited the Yique cave temple and returned to the palace the same day.

sentences.zh: 安定王超改封北平王。

translations.literal: Prince of Anding Chao was enfeoffed afresh as Prince of Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: Chao, Prince of Anding, was enfeoffed afresh as Prince of Beiping.

sentences.zh: 五月辛酉，詔曰：「揚州硤石、荊山、新淮、酇城兵士戰沒者，追給斂財，復一房五年；

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinyou: an edict said, "For soldiers killed in battle at Yangzhou's Xiashi, Jingshan, Xinhuai, and Zuo city, burial goods are granted posthumously and one household is granted five years' tax remission;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the xinyou day, an edict said, "For soldiers killed in battle at Yangzhou's Xiashi, Jingshan, Xinhuai, and Zuo city, burial goods are granted posthumously and one household is granted five years' tax remission;

sentences.zh: 若無妻子，復其家一人二年。

translations.literal: If they had no wife or children, one person of the household was granted two years' remission.
translations.idiomatic: If they had no wife or children, one person of the household was granted two years' remission.

sentences.zh: 身被三創，賞一階；

translations.literal: Those wounded in three places received one rank of reward;
translations.idiomatic: Those wounded in three places received one rank of reward;

sentences.zh: 雖一創而四體廢落者，亦同此賞。

translations.literal: Even with one wound, if the four limbs were crippled, the reward was the same.
translations.idiomatic: Even with one wound, if the four limbs were crippled, the reward was the same.

sentences.zh: 」庚辰，重申天文之禁，犯者以大辟論。

translations.literal: " Day gengchen: the prohibition on astronomical matters was reaffirmed; violators were sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: " On the gengchen day the prohibition on astronomical matters was reaffirmed; violators were sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，鄧至國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Dengzhi sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day Dengzhi sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙丑，地伏羅、罽賓國並遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day yichou: Divuoluo and Kasmira both sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the yichou day, Divuoluo and Kasmira both sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，中書監、儀同三司、汝南王悅坐殺人免官，以王還第。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Director of the Secretariat, Equal in Rank with the Three Excellencies, Prince of Runan Yue was removed from office for killing a man and sent home as a prince.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day Yue, director of the secretariat, equal in rank with the three excellencies, and Prince of Runan, was removed from office for killing a man and sent home as a prince.

sentences.zh: 己巳，車駕有事於太廟。

translations.literal: Day jisi: the imperial carriage performed rites at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day the imperial carriage performed rites at the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 八月戊戌，宴太祖以來宗室年十五以上於顯陽殿，申家人之禮。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wuxu: clansmen of the lineage from Taizu aged fifteen and above were feasted in the Xianyang Hall and the rites of family kinship were observed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the wuxu day, clansmen of the lineage from Taizu aged fifteen and above were feasted in the Xianyang Hall and the rites of family kinship were observed.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔庶族子弟年未十五不聽入仕。

translations.literal: Day jihai: an edict forbade commoner youths under fifteen from entering office.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day an edict forbade commoner youths under fifteen from entering office.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「皇魏開基，道邁周漢，蟬連二都，德盛百祀，雖帝胤蕃衍，親賢並茂，而猶沉屈素履，巾褐衡門，非所謂廣命戚族，翼屏王室者也。

translations.literal: An edict said, "The Great Wei founded its state; its Way surpasses Zhou and Han; it linked the two capitals; its virtue flourished for a hundred generations; though imperial descendants multiplied and kin and worthies alike flourished, many still sank in plain conduct behind hemp cloth at the lane gate—not what is meant by broadly appointing the imperial kin to wing and screen the royal house.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said, "The Great Wei founded its state; its Way surpasses Zhou and Han; it linked the two capitals; its virtue flourished for a hundred generations; though imperial descendants multiplied and kin and worthies alike flourished, many still sank in plain conduct behind hemp cloth at the lane gate—not what is meant by broadly appointing the imperial kin to wing and screen the royal house.

sentences.zh: 今可依世近遠，敍之列位。

translations.literal: Now according to nearness in generation they may be ranked in order of precedence.
translations.idiomatic: Now according to nearness in generation they may be ranked in order of precedence.

sentences.zh: 」庚子，詔咸陽、京兆二王子女還附屬籍。

translations.literal: " Day gengzi: an edict ordered the children of the Princes of Xianyang and Jingzhao returned to their affiliated registers.
translations.idiomatic: " On the gengzi day an edict ordered the children of the Princes of Xianyang and Jingzhao returned to their affiliated registers.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，吐谷渾國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔侍中、太師、高陽王雍入居門下，參決尚書奏事。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: an edict ordered Attendant at the Secretariat, Grand Preceptor, Prince of Gaoyang Yong to enter the Gate Department and participate in deciding Secretariat memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day an edict ordered Yong, attendant at the secretariat, grand preceptor, and Prince of Gaoyang, to enter the Gate Department and participate in deciding Secretariat memorials.

sentences.zh: 己酉，契丹國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Khitan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day Khitan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 九月辛酉，吐谷渾國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinyou: Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the xinyou day, Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔曰：「察訟理冤，實維政首，躬親聽覽，民信所由。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: an edict said, "Examining lawsuits and righting wrongs is truly the head of government; personally hearing and viewing is the source of the people's trust.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day an edict said, "Examining lawsuits and righting wrongs is truly the head of government; personally hearing and viewing is the source of the people's trust.

sentences.zh: 比日諒闇之中，治綱未振，獄犴繁廣，嗟訴驟聞，雖曰司存，每多誣壅。

translations.literal: Recently in the period of mourning seclusion the governing net was not yet taut; prisons were numerous and wide; laments and appeals were suddenly heard; though there were officials in charge, many cases were falsely blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Recently in the period of mourning seclusion the governing net was not yet taut; prisons were numerous and wide; laments and appeals were suddenly heard; though there were officials in charge, many cases were falsely blocked.

sentences.zh: 曾是寡德，實深矜慨。

translations.literal: It is because our virtue is slight that we are deeply moved with compassion.
translations.idiomatic: It is because our virtue is slight that we are deeply moved with compassion.

sentences.zh: 自今月望，當暫出城闉，親納滯枉。

translations.literal: From this month's full moon we shall for a time go outside the city gate and personally receive stagnant wrongs.
translations.idiomatic: From this month's full moon we shall for a time go outside the city gate and personally receive stagnant wrongs.

sentences.zh: 主者可宣諸近遠，咸使聞知。

translations.literal: The chief officials should announce this near and far so all may hear and know."
translations.idiomatic: The chief officials should announce this near and far so all may hear and know."

sentences.zh: 」是月，城青、齊、兗、涇、平、營、肆七州所治東陽、歷城、瑕丘、平涼、肥如、和龍、九原七城。

translations.literal: That month seven cities were walled—Dongyang, Licheng, Xiaqiu, Pingliang, Feiru, Helong, and Jiuyuan—administered by the seven provinces Qing, Qi, Yan, Jing, Ping, Ying, and Si.
translations.idiomatic: That month seven cities were walled—Dongyang, Licheng, Xiaqiu, Pingliang, Feiru, Helong, and Jiuyuan—administered by the seven provinces Qing, Qi, Yan, Jing, Ping, Ying, and Si.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚寅，以幽、冀、滄、瀛四州大饑，遣尚書長孫稚，兼尚書鄧羨、元纂等巡撫百姓，開倉賑恤。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day gengyin: because You, Ji, Cang, and Ying—four provinces—suffered great famine, Ministers Changsun Zhi, Deng Xian, and Yuan Zuan were sent to tour and comfort the people and open granaries for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the gengyin day, because You, Ji, Cang, and Ying—four provinces—suffered great famine, Ministers Changsun Zhi, Deng Xian, and Yuan Zuan were sent to tour and comfort the people and open granaries for relief.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，勿吉國貢楛矢。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Wuji presented tribute arrows.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day Wuji presented tribute arrows.

sentences.zh: [2]戊戌，以光州饑弊，遣使賑恤。

translations.literal: [2] Day wuxu: because Guangzhou was famished and distressed, envoys were sent to relieve the people.
translations.idiomatic: [2] On the wuxu day, because Guangzhou was famished and distressed, envoys were sent to relieve the people.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔曰：「北京根舊，帝業所基，南遷二紀，猶有留住。

translations.literal: Day yimao: an edict said, "The northern capital is the root of our old domain; the imperial enterprise is founded there; two reigns since the southward move, many still remain.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day an edict said, "The northern capital is the root of our old domain; the imperial enterprise is founded there; two reigns since the southward move, many still remain.

sentences.zh: 懷本樂故，未能自遣，若未遷者，悉可聽其仍停，安堵永業。

translations.literal: Those who cherish their homeland and delight in the old and cannot yet leave themselves may all be allowed to stay on and settle in peace.
translations.idiomatic: Those who cherish their homeland and delight in the old and cannot yet leave themselves may all be allowed to stay on and settle in peace.

sentences.zh: 門才術藝、應於時求者，自別徵引，不在斯例。

translations.literal: Those with talent and arts fit for the needs of the time will be summoned separately and are not within this rule.
translations.idiomatic: Those with talent and arts fit for the needs of the time will be summoned separately and are not within this rule.

sentences.zh: 周之子孫，漢之劉族，遍於海內，咸致蕃衍，豈拘南北千里而已哉。

translations.literal: The sons of Zhou and the Liu clan of Han spread throughout the realm and all flourished in number—how could they be confined to a thousand li north and south alone?"
translations.idiomatic: The sons of Zhou and the Liu clan of Han spread throughout the realm and all flourished in number—how could they be confined to a thousand li north and south alone?"

sentences.zh: 」十有一月甲子，蕭衍平西將軍、巴州刺史牟漢寵遣使請降。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiazi: Xiao Yan's General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Bazhou Mou Hanlong sent envoys to request surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jiazi day, Mou Hanlong, Xiao Yan's general who pacifies the west and inspector of Bazhou, sent envoys to request surrender.

sentences.zh: 十有二月丁未，蠕蠕國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingwei: Rouran sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the dingwei day, Rouran sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 神龜元年春正月甲子，詔以氐酋楊定為陰平王。

translations.literal: First month of spring in the first year of Shengui, day jiazi: an edict enfeoffed the Di chieftain Yang Ding as Prince of Yinping.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the first year of Shengui, on the jiazi day, an edict enfeoffed the Di chieftain Yang Ding as Prince of Yinping.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以特進、江陽王繼為驃騎大將軍、儀同三司。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Special Advanced, Prince of Jiangyang Ji was made Grand General of Agile Cavalry and held equal precedence with the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day Ji, special advanced and Prince of Jiangyang, was made grand general of agile cavalry and held equal precedence with the three excellencies.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔曰：「朕沖昧撫運，政道未康，民之疾苦，弗遑紀恤，夙宵矜慨，鑒寐深懷，眷彼百齡，悼茲六極。

translations.literal: Day renshen: an edict said, "We, young and dim, hold the mandate; the way of government is not yet at peace; the people's toils and pains we have not had leisure to record and comfort; morning and evening we are moved with compassion, waking and sleeping our hearts are deeply burdened; we look upon the hundred-year span and mourn these six extremities.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day an edict said, "We, young and dim, hold the mandate; the way of government is not yet at peace; the people's toils and pains we have not had leisure to record and comfort; morning and evening we are moved with compassion, waking and sleeping our hearts are deeply burdened; we look upon the hundred-year span and mourn these six extremities.

sentences.zh: 京畿百年以上給大郡板，九十以上給小郡板，八十以上給大縣板，七十以上給小縣板；

translations.literal: Within the capital districts those a hundred and above were granted a great commandery staff, those ninety and above a small commandery staff, those eighty and above a great county staff, those seventy and above a small county staff;
translations.idiomatic: Within the capital districts those a hundred and above were granted a great commandery staff, those ninety and above a small commandery staff, those eighty and above a great county staff, those seventy and above a small county staff;

sentences.zh: 諸州百姓，百歲以上給小郡板，九十以上給上縣板，八十以上給中縣板；

translations.literal: Among the people of the provinces, those a hundred and above were granted a small commandery staff, those ninety and above an upper county staff, those eighty and above a middle county staff;
translations.idiomatic: Among the people of the provinces, those a hundred and above were granted a small commandery staff, those ninety and above an upper county staff, those eighty and above a middle county staff;

sentences.zh: 鰥寡孤獨不能自存者，賜粟五斛、帛二匹。

translations.literal: Widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary who could not support themselves were granted five piculs of grain and two bolts of silk."
translations.idiomatic: Widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary who could not support themselves were granted five piculs of grain and two bolts of silk."

sentences.zh: 」庚辰，詔以雜役之戶或冒入清流，所在職人皆五人相保，無人任保者奪官還役。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: an edict ordered that among corvée households some had falsely entered the clear current; officeholders everywhere were each to guarantee one another in groups of five; those with no one to stand surety were stripped of office and returned to corvée.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day an edict ordered that among corvée households some had falsely entered the clear current; officeholders everywhere were each to guarantee one another in groups of five; those with no one to stand surety were stripped of office and returned to corvée.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，加特進、汝南王悅儀同三司。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Special Advanced, Prince of Runan Yue was given additional equal precedence with the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day Yue, special advanced and Prince of Runan, was given additional equal precedence with the three excellencies.

sentences.zh: 秦州羌反。

translations.literal: Qinzhou Di rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: The Di of Qinzhou rebelled.

sentences.zh: 幽州大饑，民死者三千七百九十九人，詔刺史趙邕開倉賑恤。

translations.literal: Youzhou suffered great famine; three thousand seven hundred ninety-nine people died; an edict ordered Inspector Zhao Yong to open granaries for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhou suffered great famine; three thousand seven hundred ninety-nine people died; an edict ordered Zhao Yong, inspector, to open granaries for relief.

sentences.zh: 二月戊申，嚈噠、高麗、勿吉、吐谷渾、宕昌、疏勒、久末陁、末久半諸國，[3]並遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Second month, day wushen: Yanda, Goryeo, Wuji, Tuyuhun, Dangchang, Shule, Jiumotuo, Mojuoban, and other states [3] all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the wushen day, Yanda, Goryeo, Wuji, Tuyuhun, Dangchang, Shule, Jiumotuo, Mojuoban, and other states [3] all sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔以神龜表瑞，大赦改年。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: an edict, because of the Shengui auspicious omen, proclaimed a general amnesty and changed the reign title.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day an edict, because of the Shengui auspicious omen, proclaimed a general amnesty and changed the reign title.

sentences.zh: 東益州氐反。

translations.literal: East Yizhou Di rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: The Di of East Yizhou rebelled.

sentences.zh: 蠕蠕國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Rouran sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Rouran sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，以尚書右僕射于忠為儀同三司。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinyou: Right Vice Director Yu Zhong was given equal precedence with the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the xinyou day, Yu Zhong, right vice director, was given equal precedence with the three excellencies.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，儀同三司、尚書右僕射于忠薨。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Yu Zhong, Equal in Rank with the Three Excellencies and Right Vice Director, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day Yu Zhong, equal in rank with the three excellencies and right vice director, died.

sentences.zh: 南秦州氐反，遣龍驤將軍崔襲持節喻之。

translations.literal: South Qinzhou Di rebelled; General of Dragon Cavalry Cui Xi was sent bearing credentials to instruct them.
translations.idiomatic: The Di of South Qinzhou rebelled; Cui Xi, general of dragon cavalry, was sent bearing credentials to instruct them.

sentences.zh: 吐谷渾國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁酉，司徒胡國珍薨。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, day dingyou: Minister of Works Hu Guozhen died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the dingyou day, Hu Guozhen, minister of works, died.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，江陽王繼改封京兆王。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Prince of Jiangyang Ji was enfeoffed afresh as Prince of Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day Ji, Prince of Jiangyang, was enfeoffed afresh as Prince of Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，舍摩國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Shemo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day Shemo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 五月，高麗、高車、高昌諸國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Fifth month: Goryeo, Gaoche, and Gaochang all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Goryeo, Gaoche, and Gaochang all sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 自正月不雨至于六月辛卯，澍雨乃降。

translations.literal: From the first month there was no rain until the sixth month, day xinmao; soaking rain then fell.
translations.idiomatic: From the first month there was no rain until the sixth month, on the xinmao day; soaking rain then fell.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，河州民却鐵怱聚眾反，自稱水池王。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn: the people of Hezhou, Que Tiecong, gathered a crowd and rebelled and styled himself King of the Water Pool.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn the people of Hezhou, Que Tiecong, gathered a crowd and rebelled and styled himself King of the Water Pool.

sentences.zh: 詔行臺源子恭討之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Mobile Headquarters Yuan Zigong to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Yuan Zigong, mobile headquarters, to attack him.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊戌，吐谷渾國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day wuxu: Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the wuxu day, Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，開恒州銀山之禁，與民共之。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: the prohibition on Yinshan silver mines in Hengzhou was lifted and shared with the people.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day the prohibition on Yinshan silver mines in Hengzhou was lifted and shared with the people.

sentences.zh: 丁未，波斯、疏勒、烏萇、龜茲諸國並遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Persia, Shule, Wuchang, and Kucha all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day Persia, Shule, Wuchang, and Kucha all sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 八月癸丑朔，詔曰：「朕沖昧纂曆，未閑政道，皇太后殷憂在疚，始覽萬幾。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guichou, new moon: an edict said, "We, young and dim, have succeeded to the calendar and are not yet skilled in the way of government; the empress dowager, in deep sorrow, has begun to view the myriad affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the guichou day, the new moon, an edict said, "We, young and dim, have succeeded to the calendar and are not yet skilled in the way of government; the empress dowager, in deep sorrow, has begun to view the myriad affairs.

sentences.zh: 故獄犴淹枉，百姓冤弊，言念繁刑，思存降省，京師見囚，殊死以下可悉減一等。

translations.literal: Therefore prisoners linger in wrongful detention and the people suffer injustice; thinking of excessive punishments, we wish to reduce and lighten them; prisoners seen in the capital, from death downward, may all have their sentence reduced one degree."
translations.idiomatic: Therefore prisoners linger in wrongful detention and the people suffer injustice; thinking of excessive punishments, we wish to reduce and lighten them; prisoners seen in the capital, from death downward, may all have their sentence reduced one degree."

sentences.zh: 」丁巳，詔曰：「頃年以來，戎車頻動，服制未終，奪哀從役。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: an edict said, "In recent years war-chariots have moved frequently; mourning garments are not yet ended yet grief is set aside to follow service.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day an edict said, "In recent years war-chariots have moved frequently; mourning garments are not yet ended yet grief is set aside to follow service.

sentences.zh: 罔極之痛弗申，鞠育之恩靡報，非所謂敦崇至道者也。

translations.literal: The pain of boundless loss is not expressed; the grace of nurturing is not repaid—this is not what is called honoring the utmost Way.
translations.idiomatic: The pain of boundless loss is not expressed; the grace of nurturing is not repaid—this is not what is called honoring the utmost Way.

sentences.zh: 自今雖金革之事，皆不得請起居喪。

translations.literal: From now on, even when there are campaigns in metal and hide, none may request leave for home mourning."
translations.idiomatic: From now on, even when there are campaigns in metal and hide, none may request leave for home mourning."

sentences.zh: 」甲子，勿吉國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Wuji sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day Wuji sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 鐵怱相率降於行臺源子恭。

translations.literal: Tiecong and his followers successively surrendered to Mobile Headquarters Yuan Zigong.
translations.idiomatic: Tiecong and his followers successively surrendered to Yuan Zigong, mobile headquarters.

sentences.zh: 九月癸未朔，以右光祿大夫劉騰為衞將軍、儀同三司。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guiwei, new moon: Right Honorable Grand Master Liu Teng was made General of the Guard and held equal precedence with the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the guiwei day, the new moon, Liu Teng, right honorable grand master, was made general of the guard and held equal precedence with the three excellencies.

sentences.zh: 戊申，皇太后高氏崩于瑤光寺。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Empress Dowager Gao died at the Yaoguang Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day Empress Dowager Gao died at the Yaoguang Temple.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁卯，以尼禮葬於北邙。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day dingmao: she was buried at Beimang by nun rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the dingmao day, she was buried at Beimang by nun rites.

sentences.zh: 十有二月辛未，詔曰：「民生有終，下歸兆域，京邑隱賑，口盈億萬，貴賤攸憑，未有定所，為民父母，尤宜存恤。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinwei: an edict said, "Human life has an end and all return to the burial ground; within the capital hidden and exposed corpses number in the hundred millions; noble and base alike have no fixed place; as parents of the people we should especially preserve and comfort them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the xinwei day, an edict said, "Human life has an end and all return to the burial ground; within the capital hidden and exposed corpses number in the hundred millions; noble and base alike have no fixed place; as parents of the people we should especially preserve and comfort them.

sentences.zh: 今制乾脯山以西，擬為九原。」

translations.literal: Now west of Mount Ganpu is designated as the place for Jiuyuan."
translations.idiomatic: Now west of Mount Ganpu is designated as the place for Jiuyuan."

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丁亥，詔曰：「朕以沖眇，纂承寶位，夙夜惟寅，若涉淵海。

translations.literal: First month of spring in the second year, day dinghai: an edict said, "We, young and slight, have succeeded to the precious throne; morning and evening we are reverent, as if crossing a deep sea.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the second year, on the dinghai day, an edict said, "We, young and slight, have succeeded to the precious throne; morning and evening we are reverent, as if crossing a deep sea.

sentences.zh: 賴皇太后慈仁，被以夙訓。

translations.literal: We rely on the empress dowager's compassionate benevolence, covered with early instruction.
translations.idiomatic: We rely on the empress dowager's compassionate benevolence, covered with early instruction.

sentences.zh: 自臨朝踐極，歲將半紀，天平地成，四海寧乂。

translations.literal: Since holding court and treading the pinnacle, nearly half a reign has passed; heaven is level and earth at peace; within the four seas there is quiet.
translations.idiomatic: Since holding court and treading the pinnacle, nearly half a reign has passed; heaven is level and earth at peace; within the four seas there is quiet.

sentences.zh: 天道高遠，巍巍難名，猶以撝挹自居，稱號弗備，非所以崇奉坤元，允協億兆者也。

translations.literal: The Way of Heaven is high and far, lofty and hard to name; yet we still restrain ourselves and hold back, our title not complete—not what is meant by honoring and serving Earth's origin and harmonizing with the hundred millions.
translations.idiomatic: The Way of Heaven is high and far, lofty and hard to name; yet we still restrain ourselves and hold back, our title not complete—not what is meant by honoring and serving Earth's origin and harmonizing with the hundred millions.

sentences.zh: 宜遵舊典，稱詔宇內，以副黎蒸元元之望。

translations.literal: We should follow the old canon and proclaim our title throughout the realm, to answer the hope of the black-haired masses."
translations.idiomatic: We should follow the old canon and proclaim our title throughout the realm, to answer the hope of the black-haired masses."

sentences.zh: 」是月，改葬文昭皇太后高氏。

translations.literal: That month Empress Wenzhao of the Gao clan was reburied.
translations.idiomatic: That month Empress Wenzhao of the Gao clan was reburied.

sentences.zh: 二月乙丑，齊郡王祐薨。

translations.literal: Second month, day yichou: Prince of Qi Commandery You died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the yichou day, You, Prince of Qi commandery, died.

sentences.zh: 庚午，羽林千餘人焚征西將軍張彝第，毆傷彝，燒殺其子始均。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: more than a thousand guardsmen burned the residence of General Who Campaigns West Zhang Yi, beat Yi, and burned and killed his son Shi Jun.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day more than a thousand guardsmen burned the residence of Zhang Yi, general who campaigns west, beat Yi, and burned and killed his son Shi Jun.

sentences.zh: 吐谷渾、宕昌國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Tuyuhun and Dangchang both sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Tuyuhun and Dangchang both sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Day yihai: a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔求直言，諸有上書者聽密封通奏。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: an edict sought forthright speech; those who submitted memorials were permitted to seal them and have them forwarded.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day an edict sought forthright speech; those who submitted memorials were permitted to seal them and have them forwarded.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔曰：「農要之月，時澤弗應，嘉穀未納，三麥枯悴。

translations.literal: Day renyin: an edict said, "In the crucial month of farming the seasonal rains have not responded; the good grain is not yet gathered; the three wheats wither.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day an edict said, "In the crucial month of farming the seasonal rains have not responded; the good grain is not yet gathered; the three wheats wither.

sentences.zh: 德之無感，歎懼兼懷。

translations.literal: That virtue has no effect fills us with sighs and fear together.
translations.idiomatic: That virtue has no effect fills us with sighs and fear together.

sentences.zh: 可敕內外，依舊雩祈，率從祀典。

translations.literal: Let inner and outer offices follow the old rain-prayer and lead the sacrificial canon.
translations.idiomatic: Let inner and outer offices follow the old rain-prayer and lead the sacrificial canon.

sentences.zh: 察獄理冤，掩胔埋骼。

translations.literal: Examine prisons and right wrongs; cover exposed corpses and bury bones.
translations.idiomatic: Examine prisons and right wrongs; cover exposed corpses and bury bones.

sentences.zh: 冀瀛之境，往經寇暴，死者既多，白骨橫道，可遣專令收葬。

translations.literal: In the Ji and Ying regions, which formerly suffered raids, the dead were many and white bones lay across the roads—special commissioners may be sent to gather and bury them.
translations.idiomatic: In the Ji and Ying regions, which formerly suffered raids, the dead were many and white bones lay across the roads—special commissioners may be sent to gather and bury them.

sentences.zh: 賑窮恤寡，救疾存老，準訪前式，務令周備。

translations.literal: Relieve the poor and comfort the widowed; heal the sick and preserve the aged; consult former models and see that all is thoroughly done."
translations.idiomatic: Relieve the poor and comfort the widowed; heal the sick and preserve the aged; consult former models and see that all is thoroughly done."

sentences.zh: 」三月甲辰，澍雨大洽。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiachen: soaking rain fell abundantly.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the jiachen day, soaking rain fell abundantly.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙丑，嚈噠國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, day yichou: Yanda sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the yichou day, Yanda sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 五月戊戌，以司空、任城王澄為司徒，驃騎大將軍、儀同三司、京兆王繼為司空。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuxu: Minister of Works, Prince of Rencheng Cheng was made Minister over the Masses; Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Equal in Rank with the Three Excellencies, Prince of Jingzhao Ji was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the wuxu day, Cheng, minister of works and Prince of Rencheng, was made minister over the masses; Ji, grand general of agile cavalry, equal in rank with the three excellencies, and Prince of Jingzhao, was made minister of works.

sentences.zh: 秋八月己未，御史中尉、東平王匡坐事削除官爵。

translations.literal: Eighth month of autumn, day jiwei: Censor-in-Chief, Prince of Dongping Kuang was punished for an offense and stripped of office and rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on the jiwei day, Kuang, censor-in-chief and Prince of Dongping, was punished for an offense and stripped of office and rank.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以左光祿大夫皇甫集為征西將軍、儀同三司。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Left Honorable Grand Master Huangfu Ji was made General Who Campaigns West and held equal precedence with the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day Huangfu Ji, left honorable grand master, was made general who campaigns west and held equal precedence with the three excellencies.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅，皇太后幸崧高山；

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengyin: the empress dowager visited Mount Song;
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the gengyin day, the empress dowager visited Mount Song;

sentences.zh: 癸巳，還宮。

translations.literal: Day guisi: she returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day she returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 瀛州民劉宣明謀反，事覺伏誅。

translations.literal: The people of Yingzhou, Liu Xuanming, plotted rebellion; when the matter was discovered he was executed.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Yingzhou, Liu Xuanming, plotted rebellion; when the matter was discovered he was executed.

sentences.zh: 冬十有一月乙酉，蠕蠕莫緣梁賀侯豆率男女七百人來降。

translations.literal: Eleventh month of winter, day yiyou: Rouran's Mohulian Hehoudou led seven hundred men and women to come and surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on the yiyou day, Rouran's Mohulian Hehoudou led seven hundred men and women to come and surrender.

sentences.zh: 十有二月癸丑，司徒、任城王澄薨。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guichou: Minister over the Masses, Prince of Rencheng Cheng died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the guichou day, Cheng, minister over the masses and Prince of Rencheng, died.

sentences.zh: 庚申，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 詔除淫祀，焚諸雜神。

translations.literal: An edict abolished licentious sacrifices and burned miscellaneous gods.
translations.idiomatic: An edict abolished licentious sacrifices and burned miscellaneous gods.

sentences.zh: 是歲，高麗王雲死，以世子安為其國王。

translations.literal: That year the king of Goryeo, Yun, died; his heir An was made king of that state.
translations.idiomatic: That year the king of Goryeo, Yun, died; his heir An was made king of that state.

sentences.zh: 正光元年春正月乙酉，詔曰：「建國緯民，立教為本，尊師崇道，茲典自昔。

translations.literal: First month of spring in the first year of Zhenguang, day yiyou: an edict said, "Founding the state and binding the people—establishing teaching is the root; honoring teachers and exalting the Way is the canon from of old.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the first year of Zhenguang, on the yiyou day, an edict said, "Founding the state and binding the people—establishing teaching is the root; honoring teachers and exalting the Way is the canon from of old.

sentences.zh: 來歲仲陽，節和氣潤，釋奠孔顏，乃其時也。

translations.literal: Next year in mid-yang the season is harmonious and qi moist; offering sacrifice to Confucius and Yan Hui—that is the time.
translations.idiomatic: Next year in mid-yang the season is harmonious and qi moist; offering sacrifice to Confucius and Yan Hui—that is the time.

sentences.zh: 有司可豫繕國學，圖飾聖賢，置官簡牲，擇吉備禮。」

translations.literal: The relevant offices should beforehand repair the National University, depict and adorn the sages, appoint officers and select victims, choose an auspicious day and prepare the rites."
translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices should beforehand repair the National University, depict and adorn the sages, appoint officers and select victims, choose an auspicious day and prepare the rites."

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙辰，詔尚書長孫稚巡撫北藩，觀察風俗。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, day bingchen: an edict ordered Minister Changsun Zhi to tour the northern frontier and observe customs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the bingchen day, an edict ordered Changsun Zhi, minister, to tour the northern frontier and observe customs.

sentences.zh: 五月辛巳，詔曰：「朕以寡薄，運膺寶圖，雖未明求衣，惕懼終日，而闇昧多闕，炎旱為災，在予之愧，無忘寢食。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinsi: an edict said, "We, slight and few, have received the precious chart; though we have not yet sought robes at dawn, we are wary and fearful all day; yet dimness and many faults remain; heat and drought are calamities; the blame rests on us and we cannot forget it even in sleep and eating.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the xinsi day, an edict said, "We, slight and few, have received the precious chart; though we have not yet sought robes at dawn, we are wary and fearful all day; yet dimness and many faults remain; heat and drought are calamities; the blame rests on us and we cannot forget it even in sleep and eating.

sentences.zh: 今刑獄繁多，囹圄尚積，宜敷仁惠，以濟斯民。

translations.literal: Now criminal cases are numerous and the prisons still hold many; benevolence and kindness should be spread to aid these people.
translations.idiomatic: Now criminal cases are numerous and the prisons still hold many; benevolence and kindness should be spread to aid these people.

sentences.zh: 八座可推鞠見囚，務申枉濫。

translations.literal: The Eight Seats should examine and try visible prisoners and strive to declare wrongful excess."
translations.idiomatic: The Eight Seats should examine and try visible prisoners and strive to declare wrongful excess."

sentences.zh: 」癸未，詔曰：「攘災招應，修政為本，民乃神主，實宜率先。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: an edict said, "Warding off calamity and summoning response—repairing government is the root; the people are the spirits' master and should truly take the lead.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day an edict said, "Warding off calamity and summoning response—repairing government is the root; the people are the spirits' master and should truly take the lead.

sentences.zh: 刺史守令與朕共治天下，宜哀矜勿喜，視民如傷。

translations.literal: Inspectors and prefects share in governing the realm with us; they should pity and not rejoice, viewing the people as if wounded.
translations.idiomatic: Inspectors and prefects share in governing the realm with us; they should pity and not rejoice, viewing the people as if wounded.

sentences.zh: 況今炎旱歷時，萬時彫弊，而不撫恤窮冤，理決庶獄。

translations.literal: Moreover heat and drought have lasted through the seasons and the myriad things are withered and worn—yet they do not comfort the poor and wronged or decide the multitude of lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover heat and drought have lasted through the seasons and the myriad things are withered and worn—yet they do not comfort the poor and wronged or decide the multitude of lawsuits.

sentences.zh: 可嚴敕州郡，善加綏隱，務盡聰明，加之祗肅，必使事允人神，時致靈應。

translations.literal: Let orders be sternly sent to provinces and commanderies to soothe and shelter well, striving for full discernment and adding reverence, so that affairs accord between men and spirits and timely spiritual response is achieved.
translations.idiomatic: Let orders be sternly sent to provinces and commanderies to soothe and shelter well, striving for full discernment and adding reverence, so that affairs accord between men and spirits and timely spiritual response is achieved.

sentences.zh: 其賦役不便於民者，具以狀聞，便當蠲罷。」

translations.literal: Where tax and corvée are inconvenient for the people, list them in full by memorial and they will at once be remitted and abolished."
translations.idiomatic: Where tax and corvée are inconvenient for the people, list them in full by memorial and they will at once be remitted and abolished."

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙子，侍中元叉、中侍中劉騰奉帝幸前殿，[4]矯皇太后詔曰：「魏有天下，弈葉重光。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day bingzi: Attendant at the Secretariat Yuan Cha and Palace Attendant Liu Teng escorted the emperor to the front hall, [4] and forged an edict of the empress dowager saying, "Wei has possessed the realm; generation after generation its light has been renewed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the bingzi day, Yuan Cha, attendant at the secretariat, and Liu Teng, palace attendant, escorted the emperor to the front hall, [4] and forged an edict of Empress Dowager Hu saying, "Wei has possessed the realm; generation after generation its light has been renewed.

sentences.zh: 高祖孝文皇帝，以英聖馭天，徙京定鼎。

translations.literal: Gaozu, Emperor Xiaowen, with heroic sagacity ruled Heaven and moved the capital to fix the tripod.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu, Emperor Xiaowen, with heroic sagacity ruled Heaven and moved the capital to fix the tripod.

sentences.zh: 世宗宣武皇帝，以睿明承業，廓寧區夏，而鴻勳未半，早已登遐。

translations.literal: Shizong, Emperor Xuanwu, with keen brilliance inherited the enterprise and pacified the realm; yet his great merit was not half done when he early ascended afar.
translations.idiomatic: Shizong, Emperor Xuanwu, with keen brilliance inherited the enterprise and pacified the realm; yet his great merit was not half done when he early ascended afar.

sentences.zh: 乃令車書弗同，鯨寇尚熾。

translations.literal: Thus chariots and writing were not yet uniform and whale-bandits still blazed.
translations.idiomatic: Thus chariots and writing were not yet uniform and whale-bandits still blazed.

sentences.zh: 幼主稚弱，夙纂寶曆，曾是宗祏，莫克祗奉，朕所以敬順羣請，臨朝總政。

translations.literal: The young lord is tender and weak; from childhood he has inherited the precious calendar; the altars of the lineage could not be reverently upheld—therefore we respectfully followed the multitude's request and held court to govern all affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The young lord is tender and weak; from childhood he has inherited the precious calendar; the altars of the lineage could not be reverently upheld—therefore we respectfully followed the multitude's request and held court to govern all affairs.

sentences.zh: 帝年以長，久思退身，所以往歲殷勤，具陳情旨，百官內外，已照此懷。

translations.literal: The emperor's years are already long; for long he has wished to withdraw; therefore last year, earnestly and repeatedly, we fully stated our intent; civil and military officials, inner and outer, have all understood this wish.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's years are already long; for long he has wished to withdraw; therefore last year, earnestly and repeatedly, we fully stated our intent; civil and military officials, inner and outer, have all understood this wish.

sentences.zh: 而僉爾眾意，苦見勤奪，僶俛從事，以迄于茲。

translations.literal: Yet the unanimous will of all pressed us; we were painfully compelled to accept; we bent our efforts to the task until now.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the unanimous will of all pressed us; we were painfully compelled to accept; we bent our efforts to the task until now.

sentences.zh: 自此春來，先疾屢發，藥石攝療，莫能善瘳，夏首及今，數加動劇，便不堪日釐萬務，巨細兼省。

translations.literal: From this spring illness has repeatedly flared; medicines and stones could not cure it well; from early summer until now attacks have grown more severe; we can no longer daily order the myriad affairs or oversee great and small together.
translations.idiomatic: From this spring illness has repeatedly flared; medicines and stones could not cure it well; from early summer until now attacks have grown more severe; we can no longer daily order the myriad affairs or oversee great and small together.

sentences.zh: 帝齒周星紀，識學逾躋，日就月將，人君道茂，足以撫緝萬邦，諧決百揆。

translations.literal: The emperor's teeth have passed a full cycle of stars; his knowledge and learning have daily advanced; month by month he grows; the Way of the ruler flourishes—he is fully able to soothe and govern the myriad states and harmoniously decide the hundred duties.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's teeth have passed a full cycle of stars; his knowledge and learning have daily advanced; month by month he grows; the Way of the ruler flourishes—he is fully able to soothe and govern the myriad states and harmoniously decide the hundred duties.

sentences.zh: 朕當率前志，敬遜別宮，遠惟復子明辟之義，以自綏養，實望羣公逮于黎庶，深鑒斯理。

translations.literal: We shall lead the former intent and respectfully yield to a separate palace; far considering the meaning of restoring the son and illumining the regent, we shall nurture ourselves thereby; we truly hope that the lords and the black-haired masses will deeply reflect on this principle.
translations.idiomatic: We shall lead the former intent and respectfully yield to a separate palace; far considering the meaning of restoring the son and illumining the regent, we shall nurture ourselves thereby; we truly hope that the lords and the black-haired masses will deeply reflect on this principle.

sentences.zh: 如此，則上下休嘉，天地清晏，魏道熙隆，人神慶悅，不其善歟？

translations.literal: If so, then above and below will be blessed and fine, heaven and earth clear and tranquil; Wei's Way will flourish and men and spirits rejoice—is this not good?"
translations.idiomatic: If so, then above and below will be blessed and fine, heaven and earth clear and tranquil; Wei's Way will flourish and men and spirits rejoice—is this not good?"

sentences.zh: 」乃幽皇太后於北宮，殺太傅、領太尉、清河王懌，總勒禁旅，決事殿中。

translations.literal: Thereupon Empress Dowager Hu was confined in the Northern Palace; Grand Tutor, Grand Minister, Prince of Qinghe Yi was killed; they took command of the forbidden guard and decided affairs in the palace hall.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Empress Dowager Hu was confined in the Northern Palace; Yi, grand tutor, grand minister, and Prince of Qinghe, was killed; they took command of the forbidden guard and decided affairs in the palace hall.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，帝加元服，大赦，改年，內外百官進位一等。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: the emperor performed the capping rite; a general amnesty; the reign title was changed; civil and military officials within and without were promoted one rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day the emperor performed the capping rite; a general amnesty was proclaimed; the reign title was changed; civil and military officials within and without were promoted one rank.

sentences.zh: 八月甲寅，相州刺史、中山王熙舉兵欲誅叉、騰，不果見殺。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiayin: Inspector of Xiangzhou, Prince of Zhongshan Xi raised troops intending to execute Cha and Teng; he did not succeed and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jiayin day, Xi, inspector of Xiangzhou and Prince of Zhongshan, raised troops intending to execute Cha and Teng; he did not succeed and was killed.

sentences.zh: 九月壬辰，蠕蠕主阿那瓌來奔。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renchen: the lord of Rouran, Anagui, came as a fugitive.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the renchen day, the lord of Rouran, Anagui, came as a fugitive.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以太師高陽王雍為丞相，加後部羽葆、鼓吹、班劍四十人。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Grand Preceptor, Prince of Gaoyang Yong was made Chancellor and granted rear guard of feather canopy, drums and pipes, and forty guards with ceremonial swords.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day Yong, grand preceptor and Prince of Gaoyang, was made chancellor and granted rear guard of feather canopy, drums and pipes, and forty guards with ceremonial swords.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙卯，[5]以驃騎大將軍、儀同三司、汝南王悅為太尉公。
