translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day yimao, [5] Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Equal in Rank with the Three Excellencies, Prince of Runan Yue was made Grand Minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the yimao day, [5] Yue, grand general of agile cavalry, equal in rank with the three excellencies, and Prince of Runan, was made grand minister.

sentences.zh: 十有一月己亥，詔曰：「蠕蠕世雄朔方，擅制漠裔，隣通上國，百有餘載。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jihai: an edict said, "Rouran for generations was hero of the northern frontier and held sole sway over the desert marches; neighboring our upper state for more than a hundred years.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jihai day, an edict said, "Rouran for generations was hero of the northern frontier and held sole sway over the desert marches; neighboring our upper state for more than a hundred years.

sentences.zh: 自神鼎南底，累紀于茲，虔貢雖違，邊燧靜息，憑心象魏，潛款彌純。

translations.literal: Since the divine tripod moved south, many years have passed; though tribute was sometimes absent, the border beacons were quiet; they leaned their hearts toward our capital and their secret sincerity grew purer.
translations.idiomatic: Since the divine tripod moved south, many years have passed; though tribute was sometimes absent, the border beacons were quiet; they leaned their hearts toward our capital and their secret sincerity grew purer.

sentences.zh: 今其主阿那瓌屬離時難，邦分親析，萬里遠馳，庇命有道。

translations.literal: Now their lord Anagui, parted by the hardships of the time, his state divided and kin scattered, galloped ten thousand li and sought refuge under the Way.
translations.idiomatic: Now their lord Anagui, parted by the hardships of the time, his state divided and kin scattered, galloped ten thousand li and sought refuge under the Way.

sentences.zh: 悲同申、伍，忠孝足矜。

translations.literal: His grief matches Shen Baoxu and Wu Zixu; his loyalty and filial piety are fully worthy of pity.
translations.idiomatic: His grief matches Shen Baoxu and Wu Zixu; his loyalty and filial piety are fully worthy of pity.

sentences.zh: 方存興滅之師，以隆繼絕之舉，宜且優以賓禮，期之立功，疏爵胙土，大啟河岳，可封朔方郡開國公、蠕蠕王，食邑一千戶，錫以衣冕，加以軺車，祿恤儀衞，同乎戚蕃。

translations.literal: We should for the time being treat him with guest rites and expect merit; enfeoff him with territory and open the great rivers and mountains—he may be enfeoffed as Duke of a Commandery of Shuofang, state founding, King of Rouran, with a fief of a thousand households, granted robes and crown, and given a light carriage; salary and guards like a kin prince."
translations.idiomatic: We should for the time being treat him with guest rites and expect merit; enfeoff him with territory and open the great rivers and mountains—he may be enfeoffed as Duke of a Commandery of Shuofang, state founding, King of Rouran, with a fief of a thousand households, granted robes and crown, and given a light carriage; salary and guards like a kin prince."

sentences.zh: 」十有二月壬子，詔曰：「蠕蠕王阿那瓌，遭離寇禍，遠來投庇，邦分眾析，猶無定主，而永懷北風，思還綏集。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renzi: an edict said, "The King of Rouran, Anagui, having met with bandit calamity, came from afar to seek refuge; his state divided and his followers scattered, he still had no fixed lord; yet he ever cherished the northern wind and thought to return and gather his people.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the renzi day, an edict said, "The King of Rouran, Anagui, having met with bandit calamity, came from afar to seek refuge; his state divided and his followers scattered, he still had no fixed lord; yet he ever cherished the northern wind and thought to return and gather his people.

sentences.zh: 啟訴情切，良用愍然。

translations.literal: His petition stated his intent earnestly; we are deeply moved.
translations.idiomatic: His petition stated his intent earnestly; we are deeply moved.

sentences.zh: 夫存亡恤敗，自古通典。

translations.literal: Succoring the perishing and comforting the defeated is the common canon from of old.
translations.idiomatic: Succoring the perishing and comforting the defeated is the common canon from of old.

sentences.zh: 可差國使及彼前後三介，與阿那瓌相隨；

translations.literal: Envoys of the state may be sent, together with three envoys before and after him, to accompany Anagui;
translations.idiomatic: Envoys of the state may be sent, together with three envoys before and after him, to accompany Anagui;

sentences.zh: 并敕懷朔都督，簡銳騎二千，躬自率護，送達境首，令觀機招納。

translations.literal: and the Area Commander of Huaishuo is also ordered to select two thousand elite horsemen, personally lead and escort them to the border head, and observe the moment to summon and receive them.
translations.idiomatic: and the area commander of Huaishuo is also ordered to select two thousand elite horsemen, personally lead and escort them to the border head, and observe the moment to summon and receive them.

sentences.zh: 若彼候迎，宜錫筐篚車馬之屬，務使優隆，禮餞而返；

translations.literal: If they there welcome him, baskets of silks, carriages, horses, and the like should be granted, striving for generous elevation, and with ceremony send him off to return;
translations.idiomatic: If they there welcome him, baskets of silks, carriages, horses, and the like should be granted, striving for generous elevation, and with ceremony send him off to return;

sentences.zh: 如不容受，任聽還闕。

translations.literal: if they will not receive him, let him return to court as he sees fit.
translations.idiomatic: if they will not receive him, let him return to court as he sees fit.

sentences.zh: 其行裝資遣，付尚書量給。

translations.literal: His travel gear and dispatch funds shall be measured and given by the Secretariat."
translations.idiomatic: His travel gear and dispatch funds shall be measured and given by the Secretariat."

sentences.zh: 」辛酉，以司空、京兆王繼為司徒公。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Minister of Works, Prince of Jingzhao Ji was made Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day Ji, minister of works and Prince of Jingzhao, was made minister over the masses.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月，南秦州氐反。

translations.literal: First month of spring in the second year: South Qinzhou Di rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the second year the Di of South Qinzhou rebelled.

sentences.zh: 二月庚戌，假光祿大夫邴虬撫軍將軍以討之。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengxu: Acting Honorable Grand Master Bing Qiu was made General Who Pacifies the Army to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the gengxu day, Bing Qiu, acting honorable grand master, was made general who pacifies the army to attack them.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，車駕幸國子學，講孝經。

translations.literal: Day guihai: the imperial carriage visited the National University and lectured on the Classic of Filial Piety.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day the imperial carriage visited the National University and lectured on the Classic of Filial Piety.

sentences.zh: 三月庚午，帝幸國子學祠孔子，以顏淵配。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengwu: the emperor visited the National University to sacrifice to Confucius, with Yan Hui as secondary.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the gengwu day, the emperor visited the National University to sacrifice to Confucius, with Yan Hui as secondary.

sentences.zh: 甲午，右衞將軍奚康生於禁內將殺元叉，不果，為叉矯害。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Right Guard General Xi Kangsheng was about to kill Yuan Cha within the forbidden inner quarters; he did not succeed and was killed by Cha through a forged edict.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day Xi Kangsheng, right guard general, was about to kill Yuan Cha within the forbidden inner quarters; he did not succeed and was killed by Cha through a forged edict.

sentences.zh: 以儀同三司劉騰為司空公。

translations.literal: Liu Teng, Equal in Rank with the Three Excellencies, was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Teng, equal in rank with the three excellencies, was made minister of works.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚子，司徒京兆王繼進位太保。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, day gengzi: Minister over the Masses, Prince of Jingzhao Ji was promoted to Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the gengzi day, Ji, minister over the masses and Prince of Jingzhao, was promoted to grand guardian.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，車騎大將軍、儀同三司崔光為司徒公。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, Equal in Rank with the Three Excellencies Cui Guang was made Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day Cui Guang, grand general of chariots and cavalry and equal in rank with the three excellencies, was made minister over the masses.

sentences.zh: 蕭衍義州刺史文僧明率眾內屬。

translations.literal: Xiao Yan's Inspector of Yizhou Wen Sengming led his followers inward in submission.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Sengming, Xiao Yan's inspector of Yizhou, led his followers inward in submission.

sentences.zh: 五月辛巳，南荊州刺史桓叔興自安昌南叛。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinsi: Inspector of South Jingzhou Huan Shuxing rebelled south from Anchang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the xinsi day, Huan Shuxing, inspector of South Jingzhou, rebelled south from Anchang.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，烏萇國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Wuchang sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day Wuchang sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁巳，居密、波斯國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day dingsi: Jumi and Persia both sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the dingsi day, Jumi and Persia both sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月己巳，高昌國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jisi: Gaochang sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jisi day, Gaochang sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，勿吉國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Wuji sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day Wuji sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸丑，詔曰：「時澤弗降，禾稼形損，在予之責，夙宵震懼，雖克躬撤降，仍無招感。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day guichou: an edict said, "The seasonal rains have not descended; grain and crops are damaged in form; the blame rests on us; morning and evening we are shaken with fear; though we have personally restrained and reduced offerings, still there is no response summoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the guichou day, an edict said, "The seasonal rains have not descended; grain and crops are damaged in form; the blame rests on us; morning and evening we are shaken with fear; though we have personally restrained and reduced offerings, still there is no response summoned.

sentences.zh: 有司可修案舊典，祗行六事：圄犴淹枉，隨速鞫決；

translations.literal: The relevant offices should examine and follow the old canon and reverently carry out six measures: wrongful detention in prisons—quickly try and decide;
translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices should examine and follow the old canon and reverently carry out six measures: wrongful detention in prisons—quickly try and decide;

sentences.zh: 庶尹廢職，量加修厲；

translations.literal: common officials neglecting duty—according to measure add correction and discipline;
translations.idiomatic: common officials neglecting duty—according to measure add correction and discipline;

sentences.zh: 鰥獨困窮，在所存恤；

translations.literal: widowers and the solitary in distress—wherever they are, preserve and comfort;
translations.idiomatic: widowers and the solitary in distress—wherever they are, preserve and comfort;

sentences.zh: 役賦煩民，咸加蠲省；

translations.literal: corvée and tax that trouble the people—all add remission and reduction;
translations.idiomatic: corvée and tax that trouble the people—all add remission and reduction;

sentences.zh: 賢良讜直，以時升進，貪殘邪佞，即就屏黜；

translations.literal: the worthy and good, forthright and upright—promote in timely fashion; the greedy, cruel, wicked, and flatterers—at once remove and dismiss;
translations.idiomatic: the worthy and good, forthright and upright—promote in timely fashion; the greedy, cruel, wicked, and flatterers—at once remove and dismiss;

sentences.zh: 男女怨曠，務令會偶。

translations.literal: men and women long parted in resentment—strive to have them paired.
translations.idiomatic: men and women long parted in resentment—strive to have them paired.

sentences.zh: 庶革止懲違，有弭災沴。

translations.literal: May reform stop what violates and calamity be quelled."
translations.idiomatic: May reform stop what violates and calamity be quelled."

sentences.zh: 」八月己巳，伏羅國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jisi: Fulu sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jisi day, Fulu sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 蠕蠕後主郁久閭侯匿伐來奔懷朔鎮。

translations.literal: The latter lord of Rouran, Yujiulü Hounifa, came as a fugitive to Huaishuo garrison.
translations.idiomatic: The latter lord of Rouran, Yujiulü Hounifa, came as a fugitive to Huaishuo garrison.

translations.literal: The text is deficient.
translations.idiomatic: The text is deficient.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月辛亥，帝耕籍田。

translations.literal: First month of spring in the third year, day xinhai: the emperor plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the third year, on the xinhai day, the emperor plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚辰，以高車國主覆羅伊匐為鎮西將軍、西海郡開國公、高車王。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, day gengchen: the lord of Gaoche, Fuluo Yifu, was made General Who Pacifies the West, Duke of Xihai Commandery, state founding, and King of Gaoche.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the gengchen day, Fuluo Yifu, lord of Gaoche, was made general who pacifies the west, Duke of Xihai commandery, state founding, and King of Gaoche.

sentences.zh: 六月己巳，詔曰：「朕以沖昧，夙纂寶歷，不能祗奉上靈，感延和氣，致令炎旱頻歲，嘉雨弗洽，百稼燋萎，晚種未下，將成災年，秋稔莫覬。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jisi: an edict said, "We, young and dim, from childhood have inherited the precious calendar; we have not been able to reverently serve the upper spirits or move and extend harmonious qi; therefore heat and drought have come year after year; good rain has not soaked through; the hundred crops are scorched and withered; late plantings are not yet sown; a year of calamity is forming; the autumn harvest cannot be hoped for.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jisi day, an edict said, "We, young and dim, from childhood have inherited the precious calendar; we have not been able to reverently serve the upper spirits or move and extend harmonious qi; therefore heat and drought have come year after year; good rain has not soaked through; the hundred crops are scorched and withered; late plantings are not yet sown; a year of calamity is forming; the autumn harvest cannot be hoped for.

sentences.zh: 在予之責，憂懼震懷。

translations.literal: The blame rests on us; we are anxious and fearful, shaken in heart.
translations.idiomatic: The blame rests on us; we are anxious and fearful, shaken in heart.

sentences.zh: 今可依舊分遣有司，馳祈嶽瀆及諸山川百神能興雲雨者，盡其虔肅，必令感降，玉帛牲牢，隨應薦享。

translations.literal: Now according to the old model commissioners may be sent separately to pray at the sacred mountains and rivers and all mountains and rivers and the hundred spirits able to raise clouds and rain; let them be utterly reverent so response must descend; jade and silk and victims and oxen, as each deserves, should be offered."
translations.idiomatic: Now according to the old model commissioners may be sent separately to pray at the sacred mountains and rivers and all mountains and rivers and the hundred spirits able to raise clouds and rain; let them be utterly reverent so response must descend; jade and silk and victims and oxen, as each deserves, should be offered."

sentences.zh: 上下群官，側躬自厲，理冤獄，止土功，減膳撤懸，禁止屠殺。」

translations.literal: Officials above and below should bend themselves in self-discipline, decide wrongful cases, halt earthworks, reduce meals and withdraw music, and forbid slaughter."
translations.idiomatic: Officials above and below should bend themselves in self-discipline, decide wrongful cases, halt earthworks, reduce meals and withdraw music, and forbid slaughter."

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬子，波斯、不漢、龜茲諸國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day renzi: Persia, Buhan, and Kucha all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the renzi day, Persia, Buhan, and Kucha all sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己巳，吐谷渾國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day jisi: Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the jisi day, Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十有一月乙巳，車駕有事於圓丘。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yisi: the imperial carriage performed rites at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the yisi day, the imperial carriage performed rites at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔曰：「治歷明時，前王茂軌，考辰正律，弈代通規。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: an edict said, "Governing the calendar and clarifying the seasons is the illustrious track of former kings; examining the stars and correcting the pitch pipes is the common rule of successive ages.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day an edict said, "Governing the calendar and clarifying the seasons is the illustrious track of former kings; examining the stars and correcting the pitch pipes is the common rule of successive ages.

sentences.zh: 是以北平革定於漢年，楊偉草算於魏世。

translations.literal: Therefore the Northern Ping reform was fixed in Han times and Yang Wei drafted calculations in Wei days.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the Northern Ping reform was fixed in Han times and Yang Wei drafted calculations in Wei days.

sentences.zh: 自皇運肇基，典章猶缺，推步晷曜，未盡厥理。

translations.literal: Since our imperial fortune was first founded, the canon and statutes were still lacking; advancing the gnomon and measuring the sun's shadow did not exhaust its principle.
translations.idiomatic: Since our imperial fortune was first founded, the canon and statutes were still lacking; advancing the gnomon and measuring the sun's shadow did not exhaust its principle.

sentences.zh: 先朝仍世，每所慨然。

translations.literal: Former courts for successive reigns each sighed at this.
translations.idiomatic: Former courts for successive reigns each sighed at this.

sentences.zh: 至神龜中，始命儒官，改創疏踳，回度易憲，[7]始會琁衡。

translations.literal: By the Shengui period Confucian officers were first ordered to reform and create, correcting errors, changing the cycle and altering the statute, [7] and for the first time the armillary sphere was aligned.
translations.idiomatic: By the Shengui period Confucian officers were first ordered to reform and create, correcting errors, changing the cycle and altering the statute, [7] and for the first time the armillary sphere was aligned.

sentences.zh: 今天正斯始，陽煦將開，品物初萌，宜變耳目，所謂魏雖舊邦，其曆維新者也。

translations.literal: Now the celestial standard begins anew; yang warmth is about to open; the myriad things first sprout—it is right to renew what eye and ear perceive; this is what is called Wei an old domain yet its calendar is made new.
translations.idiomatic: Now the celestial standard begins anew; yang warmth is about to open; the myriad things first sprout—it is right to renew what eye and ear perceive; this is what is called Wei an old domain yet its calendar is made new.

sentences.zh: 便可班宣內外，號曰正光曆。

translations.literal: Let it now be proclaimed inner and outer and styled the Zhenguang calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Let it now be proclaimed inner and outer and styled the Zhenguang calendar.

sentences.zh: 又首節嘉辰，獲展丘禘，神人交和，理契幽顯，思與億兆共此維新，可大赦天下。

translations.literal: Moreover at the first festival of the year we obtained the hill sacrifice at Qiu; spirits and men joined in harmony; principle met between hidden and manifest; we wish to renew this together with the hundred millions—a general amnesty may be proclaimed throughout the realm."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover at the first festival of the year we obtained the hill sacrifice at Qiu; spirits and men joined in harmony; principle met between hidden and manifest; we wish to renew this together with the hundred millions—a general amnesty may be proclaimed throughout the realm."

sentences.zh: 」十有二月癸酉，以左光祿大夫皇甫度為儀同三司。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guiyou: Left Honorable Grand Master Huangfu Du was given equal precedence with the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the guiyou day, Huangfu Du, left honorable grand master, was given equal precedence with the three excellencies.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以車騎大將軍、尚書右僕射元欽為儀同三司，太保、京兆王繼為太傅，司徒崔光為太保。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, Right Vice Director Yuan Qin was given equal precedence with the Three Excellencies; Grand Guardian, Prince of Jingzhao Ji was made Grand Tutor; Minister over the Masses Cui Guang was made Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day Yuan Qin, grand general of chariots and cavalry and right vice director, was given equal precedence with the three excellencies; Ji, grand guardian and Prince of Jingzhao, was made grand tutor; Cui Guang, minister over the masses, was made grand guardian.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以牧守妄立碑頌，輒興寺塔；

translations.literal: Day dinghai: because prefects and magistrates rashly erected steles and eulogies and readily raised temple towers;
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, because prefects and magistrates rashly erected steles and eulogies and readily raised temple towers;

sentences.zh: 第宅豐侈，店肆商販。

translations.literal: mansions were lavish and shops traded goods.
translations.idiomatic: mansions were lavish and shops traded goods.

sentences.zh: 詔中尉端衡，肅厲威風，以見事糾劾。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Censor-in-Chief to rectify and sternly awe conduct and impeach on the basis of present facts.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the censor-in-chief to rectify and sternly awe conduct and impeach on the basis of present facts.

sentences.zh: 七品、六品，祿足代耕，亦不聽錮貼店肆，爭利城市。

translations.literal: Seventh and sixth ranks—salary sufficient to replace farming—were also not permitted to monopolize and post shop signs or contend for profit in the cities.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh and sixth ranks—salary sufficient to replace farming—were also not permitted to monopolize and post shop signs or contend for profit in the cities.

sentences.zh: 四年春二月壬辰，追封故咸陽王禧為敷城王，京兆王愉為臨洮王，清河王懌為范陽王，以禮加葬。

translations.literal: Second month of spring in the fourth year, day renchen: the late Prince of Xianyang Xi was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Fucheng; Prince of Jingzhao Yu as Prince of Lintao; Prince of Qinghe Yi as Prince of Fanyang; they were buried with enhanced rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of spring in the fourth year, on the renchen day, the late Xi, Prince of Xianyang, was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Fucheng; Yu, Prince of Jingzhao, as Prince of Lintao; Yi, Prince of Qinghe, as Prince of Fanyang; they were buried with enhanced rites.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，河間王琛、章武王融，並以貪汙削爵除名。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Prince of Hejian Chen and Prince of Zhangwu Rong were both stripped of rank and name for corruption.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day Chen, Prince of Hejian, and Rong, Prince of Zhangwu, were both stripped of rank and name for corruption.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以蠕蠕主阿那瓌率眾犯塞，遣尚書左丞元孚兼尚書，為北道行臺，持節喻之。

translations.literal: Day jimao: because the lord of Rouran Anagui led his followers to raid the frontier, Left Assistant Director Yuan Fu, concurrently Minister, was made Northern Route Mobile Headquarters bearing credentials to instruct him.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, because the lord of Rouran Anagui led his followers to raid the frontier, Yuan Fu, left assistant director and concurrently minister, was made northern route mobile headquarters bearing credentials to instruct him.

sentences.zh: 蠕蠕後主侯匿伐來朝京師。

translations.literal: The latter lord of Rouran Hounifa came to court at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The latter lord of Rouran Hounifa came to court at the capital.

sentences.zh: 宕昌國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Dangchang sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Dangchang sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 司空劉騰薨。

translations.literal: Minister of Works Liu Teng died.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Teng, minister of works, died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，阿那瓌執元孚，驅掠畜牧北遁。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer: Anagui seized Yuan Fu and drove off livestock north in flight.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer Anagui seized Yuan Fu and drove off livestock north in flight.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔驃騎大將軍、尚書令李崇，中軍將軍、兼尚書右僕射元纂率騎十萬討蠕蠕，出塞三千餘里，不及而還。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: an edict ordered Grand General Who Conquers on Horseback and Minister of the Masters of Writing Li Chong and General of the Center Army and Acting Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Zuan to lead one hundred thousand cavalry against the Rouran; they went beyond the frontier more than three thousand li, did not overtake them, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day an edict ordered Li Chong, grand general who conquers on horseback and minister of the Masters of Writing, and Yuan Zuan, general of the center army and acting right vice director of the Masters of Writing, to lead one hundred thousand cavalry against the Rouran; they went beyond the frontier more than three thousand li, failed to overtake them, and returned.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥，詔曰：「達尊斯在，齒預一焉，崇敬黃耇，先代通訓。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day xinhai, an edict stated: "The most honored is present; in years one is counted among them. Reverence for the hoary-headed is a teaching of former ages.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinhai day, an edict stated: "The most honored is present; in years one is counted among them. Reverence for the hoary-headed is a teaching of former ages.

sentences.zh: 故方叔以元老處位，充國緣自強見留。

translations.literal: Hence Fang Shu held office as an elder statesman, and Zhao Chongnian because of his own vigor was retained.
translations.idiomatic: Hence Fang Shu held office as an elder statesman, and Zhao Chongnian because of his own vigor was retained.

sentences.zh: 雖七十致仕，明乎典故，然以德尚壯，許其縶維。

translations.literal: Although at seventy one should retire, as the classics make clear, yet when virtue is still robust, one may be allowed to remain bound to office.
translations.idiomatic: Although at seventy one should retire, as the classics make clear, yet when virtue is still robust, one may be allowed to remain bound to office.

sentences.zh: 今庶僚之中，或年迫懸車，循禮宜退。

translations.literal: Now among the various officials some approach the age for suspension of the carriage and by ritual ought to withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: Now among the various officials some approach the age for suspension of the carriage and by ritual ought to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 但少收其力，老棄其身，言念勤舊，眷然未忍。

translations.literal: Yet to take away their strength while young and abandon their persons when old—when I think of their long service, I cannot bear it.
translations.idiomatic: Yet to take away their strength while young and abandon their persons when old—when I think of their long service, I cannot bear it.

sentences.zh: 或戴白在朝，未當外任；

translations.literal: Some wear white hair at court and are not yet fit for posts outside the capital;
translations.idiomatic: Some wear white hair at court and are not yet fit for posts outside the capital;

sentences.zh: 或停私歷紀，甫受考級；

translations.literal: some have just completed private reckonings of years and have only now received their assessment grades;
translations.idiomatic: some have just completed private reckonings of years and have only now received their assessment grades;

sentences.zh: 如此之徒，雖滿七十，聽其莅民，以終常限。

translations.literal: such persons, though they have reached seventy, may be allowed to govern the people until their regular term ends.
translations.idiomatic: such persons, though they have reached seventy, may be allowed to govern the people until their regular term ends.

sentences.zh: 或新解郡縣，或外佐始停，已滿七十，方求更敍者，吏部可依令不奏。

translations.literal: Those who have newly left prefectures and counties, or who have just ceased serving as external aides, and who, having already reached seventy, now seek reappointment—the Ministry of Personnel may, according to the edict, not memorialize them.
translations.idiomatic: Those who have newly left prefectures and counties, or who have just ceased serving as external aides, and who, having already reached seventy, now seek reappointment—the Ministry of Personnel may, according to the edict, not memorialize them.

sentences.zh: 其有高名俊德、老成髦士、灼然顯達、為時所知者，不拘斯例。

translations.literal: Those of lofty fame and outstanding virtue, elders of mature years, men plainly eminent and known to the age, are not bound by this rule.
translations.idiomatic: Those of lofty fame and outstanding virtue, elders of mature years, men plainly eminent and known to the age, are not bound by this rule.

sentences.zh: 若才非秀異，見在朝官，依令合解者，可給本官半祿，以終其身。

translations.literal: If talent is not outstanding and one now holds office at court and ought to be dismissed under the edict, he may be given half the salary of his former office for life.
translations.idiomatic: If talent is not outstanding and one now holds office at court and ought to be dismissed under the edict, he may be given half the salary of his former office for life.

sentences.zh: 使辭朝之叟，不恨歸於閭巷矣。」

translations.literal: Thus old men leaving court will not regret returning to their lanes."
translations.idiomatic: Thus old men leaving court will not regret returning to their lanes."

sentences.zh: 八月己巳，詔曰：「狂蠢肆暴，陵竊北垂，雖軍威時接，賊徒懾遁，然獯虐所過，多離其禍，言念斯弊，有軫深懷。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jisi, an edict stated: "Madness and folly run riot; they encroach on the northern marches. Though our armies press them from time to time and the bandits shrink back in fear, wherever the savage cruelty passes many are torn from their homes. When I think of this harm, my heart is deeply pained.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jisi day, an edict stated: "Madness and folly run riot; they encroach on the northern marches. Though our armies press them from time to time and the bandits shrink back in fear, wherever the savage cruelty passes many are torn from their homes. When I think of this harm, my heart is deeply pained.

sentences.zh: 可敕北道行臺，遣使巡檢，遭寇之處，饑餒不粒者，厚加賑恤，務令存濟。

translations.literal: The Northern Route Mobile Office should be ordered to send envoys on inspection tour; wherever the raiders passed, those starving with no grain to eat should be generously relieved and succored, with every effort to preserve them."
translations.idiomatic: The Northern Route Mobile Office should be ordered to send envoys on inspection tour; wherever the raiders passed, those starving with no grain to eat should be generously relieved and succored, with every effort to preserve them."

sentences.zh: 」戊寅，詔曰：「朕以眇闇，忝承鴻緒，因祖宗之基，託王公之上，每鑒寐屬慮，思康億兆。

translations.literal: Day wuyin, an edict stated: "I, small and dim, unworthily inherit the great succession; relying on the foundation of the ancestors, I rest upon the princes and dukes. Each waking and sleeping I fix my thoughts, seeking to bring peace to the hundred millions.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day an edict stated: "I, small and dim, unworthily inherit the great succession; relying on the foundation of the ancestors, I rest upon the princes and dukes. Each waking and sleeping I fix my thoughts, seeking to bring peace to the hundred millions.

sentences.zh: 比雨旱愆時，星運舛錯，政理闕和，靈祇表異，永尋夕惕，載恧于懷。

translations.literal: Lately rain and drought have been out of season, the stars and their courses err, government is not harmonious, and the spirits show prodigies. Long I search myself in evening vigil; shame fills my breast.
translations.idiomatic: Lately rain and drought have been out of season, the stars and their courses err, government is not harmonious, and the spirits show prodigies. Long I search myself in evening vigil; shame fills my breast.

sentences.zh: 宜詔百司各勤厥職，諸有鰥寡窮疾冤滯不申者，並加釐恤。

translations.literal: All hundred offices should be ordered each to be diligent in his duty; all who are widowers, orphans, destitute, ill, wronged, or detained without redress should likewise receive relief and care.
translations.idiomatic: All hundred offices should be ordered each to be diligent in his duty; all who are widowers, orphans, destitute, ill, wronged, or detained without redress should likewise receive relief and care.

sentences.zh: 若孝子順孫、廉貞義節、才學超異、獨行高時者，具以言上，朕將親覽，加以旌命。

translations.literal: If there are filial sons, obedient grandsons, men of integrity and righteous conduct, talent and learning surpassing the common, or solitary conduct lofty for the age, report them fully; I shall personally review them and confer honors."
translations.idiomatic: If there are filial sons, obedient grandsons, men of integrity and righteous conduct, talent and learning surpassing the common, or solitary conduct lofty for the age, report them fully; I shall personally review them and confer honors."

sentences.zh: 」癸未，追復故范陽王懌為清河王。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: the deceased Prince of Fanyang Yi was posthumously restored as Prince of Qinghe.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day the deceased Prince of Fanyang Yi was posthumously restored as Prince of Qinghe.

sentences.zh: 九月丁酉，庫莫奚國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingyou: the state of Kumo Xi sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingyou day, the state of Kumo Xi sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 詔侍中、太尉、汝南王悅入居門下，與丞相、高陽王雍參決尚書奏事。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Palace Attendant, Grand Commandant, and Prince of Runan Yue to enter and dwell at the Gate Below, together with Chancellor and Prince of Gaoyang Yong to decide memorials of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Yue, palace attendant, grand commandant, and prince of Runan, to enter and dwell at the Gate Below, together with Yong, chancellor and prince of Gaoyang, to decide memorials of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 冬十有一月丙申，趙郡王謐薨。

translations.literal: Eleventh month of winter, day bingshen: Prince of Zhao Commandery Mi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on bingshen day, Prince of Zhao Commandery Mi died.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，太保崔光薨。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Grand Mentor Cui Guang died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Grand Mentor Cui Guang died.

sentences.zh: 十有二月，蕭衍遣將寇邊，詔假征南將軍崔延伯討之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: Xiao Yan sent generals to raid the frontier; an edict made acting General Who Conquers the South Cui Yanbo commander to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Xiao Yan sent generals to raid the frontier; an edict made Cui Yanbo, acting general who conquers the south, commander to attack them.

sentences.zh: 以太尉、汝南王悅為太保。

translations.literal: Grand Commandant and Prince of Runan Yue was made Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: Yue, grand commandant and prince of Runan, was made grand mentor.

sentences.zh: 徐州刺史、北海王顥坐貪污削除官爵。

translations.literal: Yuan Hao, inspector of Xuzhou and Prince of Beihai, was removed from office and stripped of rank for corruption.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Hao, inspector of Xuzhou and prince of Beihai, was removed from office and stripped of rank for corruption.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月辛丑，車駕有事於南郊。

translations.literal: Fifth year, spring, first month, day xinchou: the imperial carriage performed the suburban sacrifice at the southern altar.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, spring, first month, on xinchou day, the imperial carriage performed the suburban sacrifice at the southern altar.

sentences.zh: 閏二月癸巳，嚈噠國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Intercalary second month, day guisi: the Hephthalites sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary second month, on guisi day, the Hephthalites sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 三月，沃野鎮人破落汗拔陵聚眾反，[8]殺鎮將，號真王元年。

translations.literal: Third month: the people of Woye Garrison, Po Luhan Baling, gathered a crowd and rebelled, [8] killed the garrison commander, and styled their era True King, year one.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the people of Woye Garrison, Po Luhan Baling, gathered a crowd and rebelled, [8] killed the garrison commander, and styled their era True King, year one.

sentences.zh: 詔臨淮王彧為鎮軍將軍，假征北將軍，都督北征諸軍事以討之。

translations.literal: An edict made Prince of Huaiyang Yu general who guards the army and acting general who campaigns north, grand commander of all armies of the northern campaign, to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Yu, prince of Huaiyang, general who guards the army and acting general who campaigns north, grand commander of all armies of the northern campaign, to attack them.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，高平酋長胡琛反，自稱高平王，攻鎮以應拔陵。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer: the chieftain of Gaoping, Hu Chen, rebelled, styled himself King of Gaoping, and attacked garrisons in support of Baling.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer the chieftain of Gaoping, Hu Chen, rebelled, styled himself King of Gaoping, and attacked garrisons in support of Baling.

sentences.zh: 別將盧祖遷擊破之，琛北遁。

translations.literal: Separate commander Lu Zuyuan defeated them; Chen fled north.
translations.idiomatic: Separate commander Lu Zuyuan defeated them; Chen fled north.

sentences.zh: 五月，臨淮王彧敗於五原，削除官爵。

translations.literal: Fifth month: Prince of Huaiyang Yu was defeated at Wuyuan and stripped of office and rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Yu, prince of Huaiyang, was defeated at Wuyuan and stripped of office and rank.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔尚書令李崇為大都督，率廣陽王淵等北討。

translations.literal: Day renshen: an edict made Minister of the Masters of Writing Li Chong grand commander and ordered him to lead Prince of Guangyang Yuan and others on the northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day an edict made Li Chong, minister of the Masters of Writing, grand commander and ordered him to lead Yuan, prince of Guangyang, and others on the northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 六月，秦州城人莫折太提據城反，自稱秦王，殺刺史李彥。

translations.literal: Sixth month: the people of Qin Province, Moqi Taiqi, seized the city and rebelled, styled himself King of Qin, and killed Inspector Li Yan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the people of Qin Province, Moqi Taiqi, seized the city and rebelled, styled himself King of Qin, and killed Inspector Li Yan.

sentences.zh: 詔雍州刺史元志討之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Inspector of Yong Province Yuan Zhi to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Yuan Zhi, inspector of Yong Province, to attack them.

sentences.zh: 南秦州城人孫掩、[9]張長命、韓祖香據城反，殺刺史崔遊以應太提。

translations.literal: The people of South Qin Province, Sun Yan, [9] Zhang Changming, and Han Zuxiang seized the city and rebelled, killed Inspector Cui You, and joined Taiqi.
translations.idiomatic: The people of South Qin Province, Sun Yan, [9] Zhang Changming, and Han Zuxiang seized the city and rebelled, killed Inspector Cui You, and joined Taiqi.

sentences.zh: 太提遣城人卜朝襲克高平，[10]殺鎮將赫連略、行臺高元榮。

translations.literal: Taiqi sent the townsman Bu Chao to seize Gaoping, [10] killed Garrison Commander Helian Lue and Mobile Office Director Gao Yuanrong.
translations.idiomatic: Taiqi sent the townsman Bu Chao to seize Gaoping, [10] killed Garrison Commander Helian Lue and Mobile Office Director Gao Yuanrong.

sentences.zh: 太提尋死，子念生代立，僭稱天子，號年天建，置立百官。

translations.literal: Taiqi soon died; his son Niansheng succeeded, usurped the title of Son of Heaven, styled his era Tianjian, and established the full bureaucracy.
translations.idiomatic: Taiqi soon died; his son Niansheng succeeded, usurped the title of Son of Heaven, styled his era Tianjian, and established the full bureaucracy.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，大赦。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲寅，詔吏部尚書元脩義兼尚書僕射，為西道行臺，率諸將西討。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day jiayin: an edict made Minister of Personnel Yuan Xiuyi also Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Western Route Mobile Office commander, to lead the generals on the western campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiayin day, an edict made Yuan Xiuyi, minister of personnel, also vice director of the Masters of Writing and western route mobile office commander, to lead the generals on the western campaign.

sentences.zh: 戊午，復河間王琛、臨淮王彧本封。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Prince of Hejian Chen and Prince of Huaiyang Yu had their original fiefs restored.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Chen, prince of Hejian, and Yu, prince of Huaiyang, had their original fiefs restored.

sentences.zh: 都督崔暹失利于白道，大都督李崇率眾還平城，坐長史祖瑩截沒軍資，免除官爵。

translations.literal: Commander Cui Xuan was defeated on the White Road; Grand Commander Li Chong led the army back to Pingcheng. Because Chief Clerk Zu Ying had intercepted and seized army supplies, he was removed from office and stripped of rank.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Cui Xuan was defeated on the White Road; Li Chong, grand commander, led the army back to Pingcheng. Because Chief Clerk Zu Ying had intercepted and seized army supplies, he was removed from office and stripped of rank.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，念生遣其都督楊伯年、樊元、張朗等攻仇鳩、河池二戍，東益州刺史魏子建遣將尹祥、黎叔和擊破之，斬樊元首，殺賊千餘人。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Niansheng sent his commanders Yang Bonian, Fan Yuan, Zhang Lang, and others to attack the garrisons of Qiuchou and Hechi; Inspector of East Yi Province Wei Zijian sent generals Yin Xiang and Li Shuhe to defeat them, beheaded Fan Yuan, and killed more than a thousand bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Niansheng sent his commanders Yang Bonian, Fan Yuan, Zhang Lang, and others to attack the garrisons of Qiuchou and Hechi; Wei Zijian, inspector of East Yi Province, sent generals Yin Xiang and Li Shuhe to defeat them, beheaded Fan Yuan, and killed more than a thousand bandits.

sentences.zh: 是月，涼州幢帥于菩提、呼延雄執刺史宋穎據州反。

translations.literal: That month: the chieftain of Liang Province, Yu Puti, and Huyan Xiong seized Inspector Song Ying and held the province in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: That month the chieftain of Liang Province, Yu Puti, and Huyan Xiong seized Inspector Song Ying and held the province in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 念生遣其兄高陽王天生下隴東寇。

translations.literal: Niansheng sent his elder brother, Prince of Gaoyang Tiansheng, down from Long to raid east.
translations.idiomatic: Niansheng sent his elder brother, Prince of Gaoyang Tiansheng, down from Long to raid east.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午，元志大敗於隴東，退守岐州。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiawu: Yuan Zhi was greatly defeated east of Long and withdrew to defend Qi Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiawu day, Yuan Zhi was greatly defeated east of Long and withdrew to defend Qi Province.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔曰：「賞貴宿勞，明主恒德；

translations.literal: Day bingshen, an edict stated: "Rewards honor long service; a clear-sighted lord constantly shows virtue;
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day an edict stated: "Rewards honor long service; a clear-sighted lord constantly shows virtue;

sentences.zh: 恩沾舊績，哲后常範。

translations.literal: favor reaches old merit; a sage ruler keeps the constant pattern.
translations.idiomatic: favor reaches old merit; a sage ruler keeps the constant pattern.

sentences.zh: 太祖道武皇帝應期撥亂，大造區夏；

translations.literal: Taizu, Emperor Daowu, answered the age, quelled disorder, and greatly founded the realm within the seas;
translations.idiomatic: Taizu, Emperor Daowu, answered the age, quelled disorder, and greatly founded the realm within the seas;

sentences.zh: 世祖太武皇帝纂戎丕緒，光闡王業，躬率六師，掃清逋穢；

translations.literal: Shizu, Emperor Taiwu, succeeded the martial enterprise and spread the royal work; he personally led the Six Armies and swept away the fleeing filth;
translations.idiomatic: Shizu, Emperor Taiwu, succeeded the martial enterprise and spread the royal work; he personally led the Six Armies and swept away the fleeing filth;

sentences.zh: 諸州鎮城人，本充牙爪，服勤征旅，契闊行間，備嘗勞劇。

translations.literal: the townsmen of the various provinces and garrisons had originally served as fangs and claws, toiled in campaigns, shared hardship on the march, and tasted every fatigue.
translations.idiomatic: the townsmen of the various provinces and garrisons had originally served as fangs and claws, toiled in campaigns, shared hardship on the march, and tasted every fatigue.

sentences.zh: 逮顯祖獻文皇帝，自北被南，淮海思乂，便差割強族，分衞方鎮。

translations.literal: When Xianzu, Emperor Xianwen, moved from north to south and the Huai and sea longed for order, he then divided powerful clans to guard the frontier garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: When Xianzu, Emperor Xianwen, moved from north to south and the Huai and sea longed for order, he then divided powerful clans to guard the frontier garrisons.

sentences.zh: 高祖孝文皇帝，遠遵盤庚，將遷嵩洛，規遏北疆，蕩闢南境，選良家酋胕，增戍朔垂，戎捍所寄，實惟斯等。

translations.literal: Gaozu, Emperor Xiaowen, far following Pan Geng, was about to move to Song and Luo, planned to block the northern frontier and open the southern marches, selected worthy clan chiefs, increased garrisons on the northern rim—the defense of the frontier rested on these men.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu, Emperor Xiaowen, far following Pan Geng, was about to move to Song and Luo, planned to block the northern frontier and open the southern marches, selected worthy clan chiefs, increased garrisons on the northern rim—the defense of the frontier rested on these men.

sentences.zh: 先帝以其誠效既亮，方加酬錫，會宛郢馳烽，朐泗告警，軍旗頻動，兵連積歲，茲恩仍寢，用迄于今，怨叛之興，頗由於此。

translations.literal: The late emperor, because their loyal service was already clear, was about to add further rewards, when alarms flared at Wan and Ying and at Xun and Si; battle flags moved again and again and war dragged on for years. That grace still lies dormant, down to today; the rise of resentful rebellion owes much to this.
translations.idiomatic: The late emperor, because their loyal service was already clear, was about to add further rewards, when alarms flared at Wan and Ying and at Xun and Si; battle flags moved again and again and war dragged on for years. That grace still lies dormant, down to today; the rise of resentful rebellion owes much to this.

sentences.zh: 朕叨承乾曆，撫馭宇宙，調風布政，思廣惠液，宜追述前恩，敷茲後施。

translations.literal: I unworthily inherit the heavenly succession, govern the universe, adjust the winds and spread government, and think to extend broad favor—former grace should be pursued and later bounty spread.
translations.idiomatic: I unworthily inherit the heavenly succession, govern the universe, adjust the winds and spread government, and think to extend broad favor—former grace should be pursued and later bounty spread.

sentences.zh: 諸州鎮軍貫，元非犯配者，悉免為民，鎮改為州，依舊立稱。

translations.literal: All garrison soldiers of the provinces who were not originally assigned as convicts are entirely freed as commoners; garrisons are changed to provinces and keep their former names.
translations.idiomatic: All garrison soldiers of the provinces who were not originally assigned as convicts are entirely freed as commoners; garrisons are changed to provinces and keep their former names.

sentences.zh: 此等世習干戈，率多勁勇，今既甄拔，應思報效。

translations.literal: These men for generations practiced arms and are mostly stalwart and brave; now that they are selected, they should think to repay their debt.
translations.idiomatic: These men for generations practiced arms and are mostly stalwart and brave; now that they are selected, they should think to repay their debt.

sentences.zh: 可三五簡發，討彼沙隴。

translations.literal: Draft three or five from each group to campaign against those bandits west of Long.
translations.idiomatic: Draft three or five from each group to campaign against those bandits west of Long.

sentences.zh: 當使人齊其力，奮擊先驅，妖黨狂醜，必可蕩滌。

translations.literal: When men join their strength and strike as vanguard, the demon hosts and mad rebels can surely be swept away.
translations.idiomatic: When men join their strength and strike as vanguard, the demon hosts and mad rebels can surely be swept away.

sentences.zh: 衝鋒斬級，自依恒賞。

translations.literal: Charges, beheadings, and ranks will follow the standing rewards."
translations.idiomatic: Charges, beheadings, and ranks will follow the standing rewards."

sentences.zh: 」丁酉，南秀容牧子于乞真反，殺太僕卿陸延。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: the herdsman Yu Qizhen of South Xiurong rebelled and killed Grand Master of Splendid Carriages Lu Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day the herdsman Yu Qizhen of South Xiurong rebelled and killed Lu Yan, grand master of splendid carriages.

sentences.zh: 別將尒朱榮討平之。

translations.literal: Separate commander Erzhu Rong pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: Separate commander Erzhu Rong pacified them.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，莫折念生遣都督竇雙攻盤頭郡。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Moqi Niansheng sent Commander Dou Shuang to attack Pantou commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Moqi Niansheng sent Commander Dou Shuang to attack Pantou commandery.

sentences.zh: 東益州刺史魏子建遣將竇念祖討之，斬雙，擒斬千餘人。

translations.literal: Inspector of East Yi Province Wei Zijian sent General Dou Nianzu to attack them, beheaded Shuang, and captured and beheaded more than a thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zijian, inspector of East Yi Province, sent General Dou Nianzu to attack them, beheaded Shuang, and captured and beheaded more than a thousand.

sentences.zh: 九月壬申，詔尚書左僕射、齊王蕭寶夤為西道行臺大都督，率征西將軍、都督崔延伯，又詔復撫軍將軍、北海王顥官爵，為都督，並率諸將西討。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renshen: an edict made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Prince of Qi Xiao Baoyu grand commander of the Western Route Mobile Office and ordered him to lead General Who Campaigns West and Commander Cui Yanbo; another edict restored General Who Pacifies the Army and Prince of Beihai Yan to office and rank as commander, and both were to lead the generals on the western campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renshen day, an edict made Baoyu, left vice director of the Masters of Writing and prince of Qi, grand commander of the western route mobile office and ordered him to lead Yanbo, general who campaigns west and commander; another edict restored Yan, general who pacifies the army and prince of Beihai, to office and rank as commander, and both were to lead the generals on the western campaign.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，帝幸明堂，餞寶夤等。

translations.literal: Day yihai: the emperor visited the Bright Hall and gave a farewell feast for Baoyu and the others.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day the emperor visited the Bright Hall and gave a farewell feast for Baoyu and the others.

sentences.zh: 是月，蕭衍遣將裴邃、虞鴻襲據壽春外城，刺史長孫稚擊走之，邃退屯黎漿。

translations.literal: That month: Xiao Yan sent generals Pei Sui and Yu Hong to seize and hold the outer wall of Shouchun; Inspector Changsun Zhi drove them off; Sui withdrew to camp at Lijiang.
translations.idiomatic: That month Xiao Yan sent generals Pei Sui and Yu Hong to seize and hold the outer wall of Shouchun; Changsun Zhi, inspector, drove them off; Sui withdrew to camp at Lijiang.

sentences.zh: 詔河間王琛總眾援之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Prince of Hejian Chen to gather troops to reinforce them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Chen, prince of Hejian, to gather troops to reinforce them.

sentences.zh: 衍又遣將寇淮陽，詔祕書監、安樂王鑒率眾討之。

translations.literal: Yan again sent generals to raid Huaiyang; an edict ordered Secretary Supervisor and Prince of Anle Jian to lead troops to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: Yan again sent generals to raid Huaiyang; an edict ordered Jian, secretary supervisor and prince of Anle, to lead troops to attack them.

sentences.zh: 吐谷渾主伏連籌兵討涼州，[11]于菩提棄城走，追斬之，城民趙天安復推宋穎為刺史。

translations.literal: Tuyuhun ruler Fuliancou led troops to attack Liang Province; [11] Yu Puti abandoned the city and fled; he was pursued and beheaded. The townsman Zhao Tianan again installed Song Ying as inspector.
translations.idiomatic: Tuyuhun ruler Fuliancou led troops to attack Liang Province; [11] Yu Puti abandoned the city and fled; he was pursued and beheaded. The townsman Zhao Tianan again installed Song Ying as inspector.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，營州城人劉安定、就德興據城反，執刺史李仲遵。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter: the people of Ying Province, Liu Anding and Jiudexing, seized the city and rebelled, seized Inspector Li Zhongzun.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter the people of Ying Province, Liu Anding and Jiudexing, seized the city and rebelled and seized Li Zhongzun, inspector.

sentences.zh: 城人王惡兒斬安定以降。

translations.literal: The townsman Wang E'er beheaded Anding and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: The townsman Wang E'er beheaded Anding and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 德興東走，自號燕王。

translations.literal: Dexing fled east and styled himself King of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Dexing fled east and styled himself King of Yan.

sentences.zh: 胡琛遣其將宿勤明達寇豳、夏、北華三州。

translations.literal: Hu Chen sent his general Su Qinmingda to raid the three provinces of Bin, Xia, and North Hua.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Chen sent his general Su Qinmingda to raid the three provinces of Bin, Xia, and North Hua.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔都督北海王顥率諸將討之。

translations.literal: Day renwu: an edict ordered Commander and Prince of Beihai Yan to lead the generals to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day an edict ordered Yan, commander and prince of Beihai, to lead the generals to attack them.

sentences.zh: 十有一月戊申，莫折天生攻陷岐州，執都督元志及刺史裴芬之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wushen: Moqi Tiansheng took Qi Province, seized Commander Yuan Zhi and Inspector Pei Fenzhi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wushen day, Moqi Tiansheng took Qi Province, seized Yuan Zhi, commander, and Pei Fenzhi, inspector.

sentences.zh: 高平人攻殺卜朝，共迎胡琛。

translations.literal: The people of Gaoping attacked and killed Bu Chao and together welcomed Hu Chen.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Gaoping attacked and killed Bu Chao and together welcomed Hu Chen.

sentences.zh: 十有二月壬辰，詔太傅、京兆王繼為太師、大將軍，率諸將討之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renchen: an edict made Grand Tutor and Prince of Jingzhao Ji grand preceptor and grand general and ordered him to lead the generals to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renchen day, an edict made Ji, grand tutor and prince of Jingzhao, grand preceptor and grand general and ordered him to lead the generals to attack them.

sentences.zh: 嚈噠、契丹、地豆于、庫莫奚諸國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: The Hephthalites, Khitan, Didouyu, Kumo Xi, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The Hephthalites, Khitan, Didouyu, Kumo Xi, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 汾州正平、平陽山胡叛逆。

translations.literal: The mountain Hu of Zhengping and Pingyang in Fen Province rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: The mountain Hu of Zhengping and Pingyang in Fen Province rebelled.

sentences.zh: 詔復征東將軍章武王融封爵，為大都督，率眾討之。

translations.literal: An edict restored the fief and rank of General Who Campaigns East and Prince of Zhangwu Rong and made him grand commander to lead troops to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict restored the fief and rank of Rong, general who campaigns east and prince of Zhangwu, and made him grand commander to lead troops to attack them.

sentences.zh: 山南行臺東益州刺史魏子建招降南秦氐民，復六郡十二戍，又斬賊王韓祖香。

translations.literal: Wei Zijian, eastern route mobile office director and inspector of East Yi Province, won over the Di people of South Qin, restored six commanderies and twelve garrisons, and also beheaded the bandit king Han Zuxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zijian, eastern route mobile office director and inspector of East Yi Province, won over the Di people of South Qin, restored six commanderies and twelve garrisons, and also beheaded the bandit king Han Zuxiang.

sentences.zh: 南秦賊王張長命畏逼，乃告降於蕭寶夤。

translations.literal: The bandit king of South Qin, Zhang Changming, pressed hard, then reported surrender to Xiao Baoyu.
translations.idiomatic: The bandit king of South Qin, Zhang Changming, pressed hard, then reported surrender to Xiao Baoyu.

sentences.zh: 是月，莫折念生遣兵攻涼州，城人趙天安復執刺史以應之。

translations.literal: That month: Moqi Niansheng sent troops to attack Liang Province; the townsman Zhao Tianan again seized the inspector and joined them.
translations.idiomatic: That month Moqi Niansheng sent troops to attack Liang Province; the townsman Zhao Tianan again seized the inspector and joined them.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，蕭寶夤、崔延伯大破秦賊於黑水，斬獲數萬，天生退走入隴西，涇、岐及隴東悉平。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Xiao Baoyu and Cui Yanbo greatly defeated the Qin bandits on the Black River, captured and beheaded tens of thousands; Tiansheng withdrew into Longxi; Jing, Qi, and all lands east of Long were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Xiao Baoyu and Cui Yanbo greatly defeated the Qin bandits on the Black River, captured and beheaded tens of thousands; Tiansheng withdrew into Longxi; Jing, Qi, and all lands east of Long were pacified.

sentences.zh: 以太師、大將軍、京兆王繼為太尉，餘官如故。

translations.literal: Ji, grand preceptor, grand general, and Prince of Jingzhao, was made Grand Commandant; his other offices remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: Ji, grand preceptor, grand general, and prince of Jingzhao, was made grand commandant; his other offices remained as before.

sentences.zh: 二月，以領軍將軍元叉為驃騎大將軍、儀同三司。

translations.literal: Second month: Leader of the Court Guards Yuan Cha was made Grand General Who Conquers on Horseback and Bearer of the Triple Staff.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Yuan Cha, leader of the court guards, was made grand general who conquers on horseback and bearer of the triple staff.

sentences.zh: 詔追復樂良王長命本爵，以其子忠紹之。

translations.literal: An edict posthumously restored Prince of Leliang Changming to his original rank; his son Zhong succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: An edict posthumously restored Prince of Leliang Changming to his original rank; his son Zhong succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 侍中、特進、衞大將軍穆紹為儀同三司。

translations.literal: Palace Attendant, Special Advance, and Grand General of the Guard Mu Shao was made Bearer of the Triple Staff.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Shao, palace attendant, special advance, and grand general of the guard, was made bearer of the triple staff.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，大赦。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，莫折念生遣都督楊鮓、梁下辯、姜齊等攻仇池郡城，行臺、東益州刺史魏子建遣將盛遷擊破之，斬下辯、齊等首。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Moqi Niansheng sent commanders Yang Zha, Liang Xiabian, Jiang Qi, and others to attack Qiuchi commandery; Wei Zijian, mobile office director and inspector of East Yi Province, sent General Sheng Qian to defeat them and beheaded Xiabian, Qi, and others.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Moqi Niansheng sent commanders Yang Zha, Liang Xiabian, Jiang Qi, and others to attack Qiuchi commandery; Wei Zijian, mobile office director and inspector of East Yi Province, sent General Sheng Qian to defeat them and beheaded Xiabian, Qi, and others.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔曰：「勸善黜惡，經國茂典。

translations.literal: Day renyin, an edict stated: "Encouraging good and removing evil is a splendid canon for governing the state.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day an edict stated: "Encouraging good and removing evil is a splendid canon for governing the state.

sentences.zh: 其令每歲一終，郡守列令長，刺史列守相，以定考課，辯其能否。

translations.literal: Let each year's end see prefects list magistrates and inspectors list prefects and chancellors, to fix assessment grades and distinguish ability and inability.
translations.idiomatic: Let each year's end see prefects list magistrates and inspectors list prefects and chancellors, to fix assessment grades and distinguish ability and inability.

sentences.zh: 若有濫謬，以考功失衷論。

translations.literal: If there is abuse or error, let the assessors be judged for losing the mean."
translations.idiomatic: If there is abuse or error, let the assessors be judged for losing the mean."

sentences.zh: 」是月，齊州魏郡民房伯和聚眾反。

translations.literal: That month: the people of Wei commandery in Qi Province, Fang Bohe, gathered a crowd and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: That month the people of Wei commandery in Qi Province, Fang Bohe, gathered a crowd and rebelled.

sentences.zh: 會赦，乃散。

translations.literal: An amnesty was proclaimed and they dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: An amnesty was proclaimed and they dispersed.

sentences.zh: 三月己巳，詔太尉、西道都督、京兆王繼班師。

translations.literal: Third month, day jisi: an edict ordered Grand Commandant, Western Route Commander, and Prince of Jingzhao Ji to withdraw the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jisi day, an edict ordered Ji, grand commandant, western route commander, and prince of Jingzhao, to withdraw the army.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔曰：「丞相高陽王，道德淵廣，明允篤誠，儀形太階，垂風下國，實所以予違汝弼，致治責成，宜班新制，宣之遐邇。

translations.literal: Day renshen, an edict stated: "The Chancellor, Prince of Gaoyang, is deep and broad in virtue and conduct, clear and sincere in judgment, a model on the Great Steps, spreading influence to the realm below—truly one to assist where I err and bear the charge of bringing order. The new regulations should be promulgated far and near."
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day an edict stated: "Yong, chancellor and prince of Gaoyang, is deep and broad in virtue and conduct, clear and sincere in judgment, a model on the Great Steps, spreading influence to the realm below—truly one to assist where I err and bear the charge of bringing order. The new regulations should be promulgated far and near."

sentences.zh: 其州郡先上司徒公文，悉可改上相府施行，符告皆亦如之。

translations.literal: The provinces and commanderies that formerly memorialized the Minister of Works should all now memorialize the Chancellor's office for implementation; warrants and notices are likewise.
translations.idiomatic: The provinces and commanderies that formerly memorialized the Minister of Works should all now memorialize the chancellor's office for implementation; warrants and notices are likewise.

sentences.zh: 」甲戌，詔曰：「選眾而舉，其來自昔。

translations.literal: " Day jiaxu, an edict stated: "To select the multitude and raise them up is an ancient practice.
translations.idiomatic: " On jiaxu day an edict stated: "To select the multitude and raise them up is an ancient practice.

sentences.zh: 朕纘承大業，綜理萬幾，求賢致治，心焉若渴。

translations.literal: I succeed to the great enterprise and govern the myriad affairs, seeking the worthy to bring order—my heart is as thirsty as if parched.
translations.idiomatic: I succeed to the great enterprise and govern the myriad affairs, seeking the worthy to bring order—my heart is as thirsty as if parched.

sentences.zh: 知人則哲，振古所難，宜博訪公卿，採茲聲實。

translations.literal: To know men is wisdom; it has been hard since antiquity. Broad inquiry should be made of dukes and ministers to gather true reputation.
translations.idiomatic: To know men is wisdom; it has been hard since antiquity. Broad inquiry should be made of dukes and ministers to gather true reputation.

sentences.zh: 可令第一品以下五品以上，人各薦其所知，不限素身居職。

translations.literal: From rank one down to rank five and above, each man should recommend those he knows, without limiting commoners or officeholders.
translations.idiomatic: From rank one down to rank five and above, each man should recommend those he knows, without limiting commoners or officeholders.

sentences.zh: 必使精辯器藝，具注所能，然後依牒簡擢，隨才收敍，庶濟濟之美，無替往時，謇謇之直，有申茲歲。

translations.literal: They must clearly state talent and arts and fully note what each can do; then, according to the memorial, select and promote, receiving office as talent warrants, so that the abundance of excellence may not fall short of former times and upright integrity may find scope this year."
translations.idiomatic: They must clearly state talent and arts and fully note what each can do; then, according to the memorial, select and promote, receiving office as talent warrants, so that the abundance of excellence may not fall short of former times and upright integrity may find scope this year."

sentences.zh: 」蕭衍遣其北梁州長史錫休儒、司馬魚和、上庸太守姜平洛等入寇直城，梁州刺史傅竪眼遣息敬紹率眾拒擊，大破之，擒斬三千餘人；

translations.literal: Xiao Yan sent Chief Clerk of North Liang Province Xi Xiuru, Marshal Yu He, and Administrator of Shangyong Jiang Pingluo and others to invade Zhicheng; Inspector of Liang Province Fu Shuyan sent his son Jingshao to lead troops to resist; they were greatly defeated and more than three thousand were captured and beheaded;
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yan sent Xi Xiuru, chief clerk of North Liang Province, Yu He, marshal, and Jiang Pingluo, administrator of Shangyong, and others to invade Zhicheng; Fu Shuyan, inspector of Liang Province, sent his son Jingshao to lead troops to resist; they were greatly defeated and more than three thousand were captured and beheaded;

sentences.zh: 休儒等走還魏興。

translations.literal: Xiuru and the others fled back to Weixing.
translations.idiomatic: Xiuru and the others fled back to Weixing.

sentences.zh: 是月，齊州清河民崔畜殺太守董遵，廣川民傅堆執太守劉莽反。

translations.literal: That month: the people of Qinghe in Qi Province, Cui Xu, killed Administrator Dong Zun; the people of Guangchuan, Fu Dui, seized Administrator Liu Mang and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: That month the people of Qinghe in Qi Province, Cui Xu, killed Administrator Dong Zun; the people of Guangchuan, Fu Dui, seized Administrator Liu Mang and rebelled.

sentences.zh: 青州刺史、安樂王鑒討平之。

translations.literal: Inspector of Qing Province and Prince of Anle Jian suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: Jian, inspector of Qing Province and prince of Anle, suppressed and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 是月，破落汗拔陵別帥王也不盧等攻陷懷朔鎮。

translations.literal: That month: the separate commander of Po Luhan Baling, Wang Ye Bulu, and others took Huai Shuo Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: That month the separate commander of Po Luhan Baling, Wang Ye Bulu, and others took Huai Shuo Garrison.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，蕭衍益州刺史蕭淵猷遣將樊文熾、蕭世澄等率眾圍小劍戍。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer: Xiao Yan's Inspector of Yi Province Xiao Yuanyou sent generals Fan Wenchao and Xiao Shicheng and others to besiege Little Sword Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer Xiao Yan's inspector of Yi Province Xiao Yuanyou sent generals Fan Wenchao and Xiao Shicheng and others to besiege Little Sword Garrison.

sentences.zh: 益州刺史邴虬遣子子達、行臺魏子建遣別將淳于誕拒擊之。

translations.literal: Inspector of Yi Province Bing Chou sent his son Zida; the mobile office Wei Zijian sent separate commander Chunyu Dan to resist and attack them.
translations.idiomatic: Bing Chou, inspector of Yi Province, sent his son Zida; Wei Zijian, mobile office director, sent separate commander Chunyu Dan to resist and attack them.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，皇太后復臨朝攝政，引羣臣面陳得失。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: the empress dowager again attended court and held regency, summoning the ministers to state gains and losses face to face.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the empress dowager again attended court and held regency, summoning the ministers to state gains and losses face to face.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「朕以寡昧，夙承天歷，茫若涉海，罔知所濟，實憑宗社降祐之靈，庶勉幼志，以康世道。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "I, small and dim, from youth have inherited the heavenly succession; I am as if crossing the sea, not knowing how to reach the shore. I truly rely on the spirits of the altars of soil and grain for their lowering protection, hoping to fulfill my young resolve and bring peace to the age.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "I, small and dim, from youth have inherited the heavenly succession; I am as if crossing the sea, not knowing how to reach the shore. I truly rely on the spirits of the altars of soil and grain for their lowering protection, hoping to fulfill my young resolve and bring peace to the age.

sentences.zh: 而神龜之末，權臣擅命，元叉、劉騰陰相影響，遂使皇太后幽隔後宮，太傅、清河王無辜致害，相州刺史、中山王熙橫被夷滅，右衞將軍奚康生仍見誅翦。

translations.literal: At the end of the Divine Tortoise era powerful ministers usurped command; Yuan Cha and Liu Teng secretly influenced each other, so that the empress dowager was shut away in the rear palace, the Grand Tutor and Prince of Qinghe were killed without crime, Inspector of Xiang Province and Prince of Zhongshan Xi was wantonly destroyed, and Right Guard General Xi Kangsheng was likewise executed.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Divine Tortoise era powerful ministers usurped command; Yuan Cha and Liu Teng secretly influenced each other, so that the empress dowager was shut away in the rear palace, the grand tutor and prince of Qinghe were killed without crime, Xi, inspector of Xiang Province and prince of Zhongshan, was wantonly destroyed, and Xi Kangsheng, right guard general, was likewise executed.

sentences.zh: 從此已後，無所畏忌，恣諸侵求，任所與奪。

translations.literal: From then on they feared nothing, wantonly made demands, and at their posts seized and granted as they pleased.
translations.idiomatic: From then on they feared nothing, wantonly made demands, and at their posts seized and granted as they pleased.

sentences.zh: 無君之心，積習稍久；

translations.literal: The heart without a lord accumulated over long habit;
translations.idiomatic: The heart without a lord accumulated over long habit;

sentences.zh: 不臣之迹，緣事彌彰。

translations.literal: the traces of disloyalty grew plainer with each affair.
translations.idiomatic: the traces of disloyalty grew plainer with each affair.

sentences.zh: 蔽耳目之明，專生殺之柄，天下為之不康，四郊由茲多壘。

translations.literal: They blocked the brightness of eyes and ears and monopolized the power of life and death; the realm was thereby unquiet and the four marches grew full of ramparts.
translations.idiomatic: They blocked the brightness of eyes and ears and monopolized the power of life and death; the realm was thereby unquiet and the four marches grew full of ramparts.

sentences.zh: 此而可忍，孰不可懷！

translations.literal: If this can be borne, what cannot be borne in the heart!
translations.idiomatic: If this can be borne, what cannot be borne in the heart!

sentences.zh: 雖屢經赦宥，未容致之于法，猶宜辨正，以謝朝野。

translations.literal: Though they were repeatedly pardoned and not yet handed to the law, they should still be judged and corrected to answer court and realm.
translations.idiomatic: Though they were repeatedly pardoned and not yet handed to the law, they should still be judged and corrected to answer court and realm.

sentences.zh: 騰身既往，可追削爵位。

translations.literal: Teng being already gone, his rank may be posthumously stripped.
translations.idiomatic: Teng being already gone, his rank may be posthumously stripped.

sentences.zh: 叉之罪狀，誠合徽纆，但以宗枝舅戚，特加全貸，可除名為民。」

translations.literal: Cha's crimes truly merit the cord, but because he is of the imperial clan and a maternal relative, special full pardon is granted; he may be removed from the registers and made a commoner."
translations.idiomatic: Cha's crimes truly merit the cord, but because he is of the imperial clan and a maternal relative, special full pardon is granted; he may be removed from the registers and made a commoner."

sentences.zh: 壬辰，征西將軍、都督崔延伯大敗於涇川，戰歿。

translations.literal: Day renchen: General Who Campaigns West and Commander Cui Yanbo was greatly defeated on the Jing River and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Yanbo, general who campaigns west and commander, was greatly defeated on the Jing River and died in battle.

sentences.zh: 五月戊辰，淳于誕等大破蕭衍軍，俘斬萬計，擒蕭世澄等十一將，文熾僅以身免，走成都。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuchen: Chunyu Dan and others greatly defeated Xiao Yan's army; captives and heads numbered in the tens of thousands; eleven generals including Xiao Shicheng were captured; Wenchao barely escaped with his life and fled to Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuchen day, Chunyu Dan and others greatly defeated Xiao Yan's army; captives and heads numbered in the tens of thousands; eleven generals including Xiao Shicheng were captured; Wenchao barely escaped with his life and fled to Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 戊子，[12]驃騎大將軍、儀同三司李崇薨。

translations.literal: Day wuzi, [12] Grand General Who Conquers on Horseback and Bearer of the Triple Staff Li Chong died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, [12] Li Chong, grand general who conquers on horseback and bearer of the triple staff, died.

sentences.zh: 六月癸未，大赦，改年。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guiwei: a general amnesty; the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guiwei day, a general amnesty was proclaimed; the era name was changed.

sentences.zh: 詔文武之官，從軍二百日，文官優一級，武官優二級。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that civil and military officials who had followed the army two hundred days should receive one grade of promotion for civil officials and two for military officials.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that civil and military officials who had followed the army two hundred days should receive one grade of promotion for civil officials and two for military officials.

sentences.zh: 蠕蠕主阿那瓌率眾大破拔陵，斬其將孔雀等。

translations.literal: The Rouran ruler Anagui led his horde and greatly defeated Baling, beheading his generals Kongque and others.
translations.idiomatic: The Rouran ruler Anagui led his horde and greatly defeated Baling, beheading his generals Kongque and others.

sentences.zh: 諸將逼彭城，蕭綜夜潛出降，蕭衍諸將奔退，眾軍追躡，免者十一二。

translations.literal: The generals pressed Pengcheng; Xiao Zong slipped out by night and surrendered; Xiao Yan's generals fled in retreat; the armies pursued—only one or two in ten escaped.
translations.idiomatic: The generals pressed Pengcheng; Xiao Zong slipped out by night and surrendered; Xiao Yan's generals fled in retreat; the armies pursued—only one or two in ten escaped.

sentences.zh: 秋八月癸酉，詔斷遠近貢獻珍麗，違者免官。

translations.literal: Eighth month of autumn, day guiyou: an edict forbade tribute of rare luxuries from near and far; violators were removed from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on guiyou day, an edict forbade tribute of rare luxuries from near and far; violators were removed from office.

sentences.zh: 柔玄鎮人杜洛周率眾反於上谷，號年真王，攻沒郡縣，南圍燕州。

translations.literal: The people of Rouxuan Garrison, Du Luozhou, gathered a crowd and rebelled at Shanggu, styled their era True King, overran commanderies and counties, and besieged Yan Province from the south.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Rouxuan Garrison, Du Luozhou, gathered a crowd and rebelled at Shanggu, styled their era True King, overran commanderies and counties, and besieged Yan Province from the south.

sentences.zh: 戊子，莫折念生遣都督杜黑兒、杜光等攻仇池郡。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Moqi Niansheng sent commanders Du Hei'er and Du Guang and others to attack Qiuchi commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Moqi Niansheng sent commanders Du Hei'er and Du Guang and others to attack Qiuchi commandery.

sentences.zh: 行臺魏子建遣將成遷擊破之，斬杜光首。

translations.literal: Wei Zijian of the mobile office sent General Cheng Qian to defeat them and beheaded Guang.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zijian of the mobile office sent General Cheng Qian to defeat them and beheaded Guang.

sentences.zh: 九月乙卯，詔減天下諸調之半。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yimao: an edict reduced all levies throughout the realm by half.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yimao day, an edict reduced all levies throughout the realm by half.

sentences.zh: [13]丙辰，詔左將軍、幽州刺史常景為行臺，征虜將軍元譚為都督，以討洛周。

translations.literal: [13] Day bingchen: an edict made Left General and Inspector of You Province Chang Jing mobile office commander and General Who Campaigns against Barbarians Yuan Tan commander, to attack Luozhou.
translations.idiomatic: [13] On bingchen day an edict made Chang Jing, left general and inspector of You Province, mobile office commander and Yuan Tan, general who campaigns against barbarians, commander, to attack Luozhou.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔曰：「追功表德，為善者勸。

translations.literal: Day xinyou, an edict stated: "Pursuing merit and displaying virtue encourages the good.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day an edict stated: "Pursuing merit and displaying virtue encourages the good.

sentences.zh: 祖宗功臣，勒銘王府，而子孫廢替，淪於凡民，爵位無聞，遷流有失。

translations.literal: Meritorious ministers of the ancestors were inscribed in the princely mansion, yet their descendants fell into neglect and sank among commoners; rank and title were unknown and their lines wandered in loss.
translations.idiomatic: Meritorious ministers of the ancestors were inscribed in the princely mansion, yet their descendants fell into neglect and sank among commoners; rank and title were unknown and their lines wandered in loss.

sentences.zh: 潁川名守，重泉令宰，惠風美政，結於民心，而猶同常品，未蒙褒陟，非所謂愛及甘棠，彝倫攸敍者也。

translations.literal: Famous governors of Yingchuan, magistrates of Chongquan—their gracious winds and fine government bound the hearts of the people—yet they still ranked as ordinary and received no exalted promotion; this is not what is meant by cherishing the sweet pear or putting constant order in the norms.
translations.idiomatic: Famous governors of Yingchuan, magistrates of Chongquan—their gracious winds and fine government bound the hearts of the people—yet they still ranked as ordinary and received no exalted promotion; this is not what is meant by cherishing the sweet pear or putting constant order in the norms.

sentences.zh: 其功臣名將為先朝所知，子孫屈塞不見齒敍，牧守令長聲稱卓然者，皆仰有司具以名聞。

translations.literal: Meritorious generals known to former courts whose descendants are cramped and not enrolled, and prefects, governors, magistrates, and chancellors of outstanding reputation—all should be reported by name to the relevant offices.
translations.idiomatic: Meritorious generals known to former courts whose descendants are cramped and not enrolled, and prefects, governors, magistrates, and chancellors of outstanding reputation—all should be reported by name to the relevant offices.

sentences.zh: 朕將振彼幽滯，用闡治風。

translations.literal: I shall raise those sunk in obscurity and spread the wind of good government."
translations.idiomatic: I shall raise those sunk in obscurity and spread the wind of good government."

sentences.zh: 」壬戌，詔百官五品已上，各舉所知。

translations.literal: Day renxu: an edict ordered all officials of rank five and above each to recommend those they knew.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day an edict ordered all officials of rank five and above each to recommend those they knew.

sentences.zh: 辛未，曲赦南、北兩秦州。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: a partial amnesty for South and North Qin provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day a partial amnesty was proclaimed for South and North Qin provinces.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，蠕蠕國主阿那瓌遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter: the Rouran ruler Anagui sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter the Rouran ruler Anagui sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 是月，吐谷渾國復討趙天安，降之。

translations.literal: That month: Tuyuhun again attacked Zhao Tianan and made him surrender.
translations.idiomatic: That month Tuyuhun again attacked Zhao Tianan and made him surrender.

sentences.zh: 河州長史元永平、治中孟賓等推嚈噠使主高徽行州事，而前刺史梁釗子景進攻殺之，景進又自行州事。

translations.literal: Chief Clerk of He Province Yuan Yongping and Administrator Meng Bin and others installed the Hephthalite envoy-lord Gao Hui to act as provincial governor; the former inspector Liang Zhao's son Jingjin attacked and killed him; Jingjin then acted as provincial governor himself.
