translations.idiomatic: Yuan Yongping, chief clerk of He Province, and Meng Bin, administrator, and others installed the Hephthalite envoy-lord Gao Hui to act as provincial governor; Jingjin, son of the former inspector Liang Zhao, attacked and killed him; Jingjin then acted as provincial governor himself.

sentences.zh: 十有一月辛亥，詔曰：「大孝榮親，著之昔典，故安平耄耋，諸子滿朝。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinhai, an edict stated: "Great filial piety honors kin; this is set out in ancient canons. Hence the peace of Ping in old age filled the court with sons.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinhai day, an edict stated: "Great filial piety honors kin; this is set out in ancient canons. Hence the peace of Ping in old age filled the court with sons.

sentences.zh: 自今諸有父母年八十以上者，皆聽居官祿養，溫清朝夕。

translations.literal: From now on, all whose parents are eighty or more may be allowed to hold office and receive salary to support them, warm in court morning and evening."
translations.idiomatic: From now on, all whose parents are eighty or more may be allowed to hold office and receive salary to support them, warm in court morning and evening."

sentences.zh: 」時四方多事，諸蠻復反。

translations.literal: At that time affairs were many on all sides and the various Man rebelled again.
translations.idiomatic: At that time affairs were many on all sides and the various Man rebelled again.

sentences.zh: 十有二月壬午，詔曰：「高祖以大明定功，世宗以下武寧亂，聲溢朔南，化清中宇，業盛隆周，祚延七百。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renwu, an edict stated: "Gaozu by great clarity fixed merit; Shizong by martial power settled disorder—fame overflowed north and south, transformation cleared the central realm; the enterprise rivaled prosperous Zhou and the throne extended seven hundred years.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renwu day, an edict stated: "Gaozu by great clarity fixed merit; Shizong by martial power settled disorder—fame overflowed north and south, transformation cleared the central realm; the enterprise rivaled prosperous Zhou and the throne extended seven hundred years.

sentences.zh: 朕幼齡纂曆，夙馭鴻基，戰戰兢兢，若臨淵谷。

translations.literal: I, young in years, succeeded to the calendar; from youth I have driven the great foundation, fearful and cautious as if standing over an abyss.
translations.idiomatic: I, young in years, succeeded to the calendar; from youth I have driven the great foundation, fearful and cautious as if standing over an abyss.

sentences.zh: 闇於治道，政刑未孚，權臣擅命，亂我朝式。

translations.literal: Dim in the way of government, punishments and grace not yet won, powerful ministers usurped command and disturbed our court pattern.
translations.idiomatic: Dim in the way of government, punishments and grace not yet won, powerful ministers usurped command and disturbed our court pattern.

sentences.zh: 致使西秦跋扈，朔漠構妖，蠢爾荊蠻，氛埃不息。

translations.literal: They caused West Qin to run riot, the northern desert to breed demons, and the stupid Man of Jing to seethe without cease.
translations.idiomatic: They caused West Qin to run riot, the northern desert to breed demons, and the stupid Man of Jing to seethe without cease.

sentences.zh: 孔熾甚於涇陽，出軍切於細柳。

translations.literal: The peril exceeded Jingyang; raising armies was as urgent as Xiliu.
translations.idiomatic: The peril exceeded Jingyang; raising armies was as urgent as Xiliu.

sentences.zh: 而師旅盤桓，留滯不進，北淯懸危，南陽告急，將虧荊沔之地，以致蹙國之憂。

translations.literal: Yet the armies lingered and did not advance; the northern ford hung in peril and Nanyang cried urgent alarm—lands of Jing and Mian were about to be lost and the state brought to crushing grief.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the armies lingered and did not advance; the northern ford hung in peril and Nanyang cried urgent alarm—lands of Jing and Mian were about to be lost and the state brought to crushing grief.

sentences.zh: 今茅轂扼腕，爪牙歎憤，並欲摧挫封豕，剿截長蛇，使人神兩泰，幽明獻吉。

translations.literal: Now the thatched carriage wrings its wrists and claws and fangs sigh in anger; all wish to break the great boar and cut the long serpent, so that man and spirit are both at peace and the hidden and manifest offer good omens.
translations.idiomatic: Now the thatched carriage wrings its wrists and claws and fangs sigh in anger; all wish to break the great boar and cut the long serpent, so that man and spirit are both at peace and the hidden and manifest offer good omens.

sentences.zh: 朕將躬馭六師，掃蕩逋穢。

translations.literal: I shall personally drive the Six Armies and sweep away the fleeing filth.
translations.idiomatic: I shall personally drive the Six Armies and sweep away the fleeing filth.

sentences.zh: 其配衣六軍，分隸熊虎，前驅後隊，左翼右師，必令將帥雄果，軍吏明濟，糧仗車馬，速度時須。

translations.literal: Those assigned to the Six Armies, divided under bear and tiger, vanguard and rear, left wing and right division—generals and commanders must be bold and resolute, staff officers clear and able; grain, weapons, chariots, and horses must be ready when needed.
translations.idiomatic: Those assigned to the Six Armies, divided under bear and tiger, vanguard and rear, left wing and right division—generals and commanders must be bold and resolute, staff officers clear and able; grain, weapons, chariots, and horses must be ready when needed.

sentences.zh: 其有失律亡軍、兵戍逃叛、盜賊劫掠伏竄山澤者，免其往咎，錄其後効，別立募格，聽其自新，廣下州郡，令赴軍所。

translations.literal: Those who lost discipline and perished in battle, soldiers and garrisons who fled, bandits and raiders hiding in mountains and marshes—their past faults are forgiven and later merit recorded; separate recruitment standards are set, they may renew themselves, and orders are sent broadly to provinces and commanderies to come to the army rendezvous.
translations.idiomatic: Those who lost discipline and perished in battle, soldiers and garrisons who fled, bandits and raiders hiding in mountains and marshes—their past faults are forgiven and later merit recorded; separate recruitment standards are set, they may renew themselves, and orders are sent broadly to provinces and commanderies to come to the army rendezvous.

sentences.zh: 今先討荊蠻，疆理南服；

translations.literal: First attack the Man of Jing and settle the southern marches;
translations.idiomatic: First attack the Man of Jing and settle the southern marches;

sentences.zh: 戈旗東指，掃平淮外。

translations.literal: banners and spears point east to sweep the Huai region.
translations.idiomatic: banners and spears point east to sweep the Huai region.

sentences.zh: 然後奮七萃於西戎，騰五牛於北狄；

translations.literal: then rouse the seven hosts on the western barbarians and gallop the five oxen against the northern Di;
translations.idiomatic: then rouse the seven hosts on the western barbarians and gallop the five oxen against the northern Di;

sentences.zh: 躬撫亂離之苦，面恤饑寒之患。

translations.literal: personally soothe the suffering of the displaced and face to face comfort the hungry and cold.
translations.idiomatic: personally soothe the suffering of the displaced and face to face comfort the hungry and cold.

sentences.zh: 爾乃還蹕嵩宇，飲至廟庭，沉璧河洛，告成泰岱，豈不盛歟！

translations.literal: then return to halt at Song heights, drink to the end at the temple court, sink the jade disk in He and Luo, and report completion at Mount Tai—how glorious!"
translations.idiomatic: then return to halt at Song heights, drink to the end at the temple court, sink the jade disk in He and Luo, and report completion at Mount Tai—how glorious!"

sentences.zh: 百官內外、牧守軍宰，宜各肅勤，用明爾職。

translations.literal: All civil and military officials within and without, governors and army commanders, should each be diligent and clarify their duties."
translations.idiomatic: All civil and military officials within and without, governors and army commanders, should each be diligent and clarify their duties."

sentences.zh: 」山胡劉蠡升反，自稱天子，置官僚。

translations.literal: The mountain Hu Liu Lisheng rebelled, styled himself Son of Heaven, and established officials.
translations.idiomatic: The mountain Hu Liu Lisheng rebelled, styled himself Son of Heaven, and established officials.

sentences.zh: 是月，以臨淮王彧為征南大將軍，率眾討魯陽蠻。

translations.literal: That month: Prince of Huaiyang Yu was made General Who Campaigns South and led troops to attack the Man of Luyang.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yu, prince of Huaiyang, was made general who campaigns south and led troops to attack the Man of Luyang.

sentences.zh: 二月甲申，帝、皇太后臨大夏門，親覽冤訟。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiashen: the emperor and empress dowager attended the Great Summer Gate and personally reviewed wrongful suits.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiashen day, the emperor and empress dowager attended the Great Summer Gate and personally reviewed wrongful suits.

sentences.zh: 是月，疊伏羅國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That month: the state of Diefuoluo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That month the state of Diefuoluo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子，以驃騎大將軍、徐州刺史、安豐王延明為儀同三司。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengzi: Prince of Anfeng Yanming, Grand General Who Conquers on Horseback and Inspector of Xuzhou, was made Bearer of the Triple Staff.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengzi day, Yanming, prince of Anfeng, grand general who conquers on horseback and inspector of Xuzhou, was made bearer of the triple staff.

sentences.zh: 追復中山王熙本爵，子叔仁紹之。

translations.literal: Prince of Zhongshan Xi's original rank was posthumously restored; his son Shuren succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: Xi, prince of Zhongshan's original rank was posthumously restored; his son Shuren succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，西部敕勒斛律洛陽反於桑乾，西與河西牧子通連。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: the western Tiele Huluoyang rebelled at Sanggan and linked with the herdsmen of Hexi to the west.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the western Tiele Huluoyang rebelled at Sanggan and linked with the herdsmen of Hexi to the west.

sentences.zh: 別將尒朱榮擊破之。

translations.literal: Separate commander Erzhu Rong defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Separate commander Erzhu Rong defeated them.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer: a general amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以侍中、車騎大將軍、城陽王徽為儀同三司。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Palace Attendant, General of Chariots and Cavalry, and Prince of Chengyang Hui was made Bearer of the Triple Staff.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Hui, palace attendant, general of chariots and cavalry, and prince of Chengyang, was made bearer of the triple staff.

sentences.zh: 朔州城人鮮于阿胡、厙狄豐樂據城反。

translations.literal: The people of Shuozhou, Xianyu Ahu and Kudifengle, seized the city and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Shuozhou, Xianyu Ahu and Kudifengle, seized the city and rebelled.

sentences.zh: 丁未，都督李琚次於薊城之北，又為洛周所敗，琚戰沒。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Commander Li Ju halted north of Ji city and was again defeated by Luozhou; Ju died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Commander Li Ju halted north of Ji city and was again defeated by Luozhou; Ju died in battle.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以驃騎大將軍、開府、齊王寶夤為儀同三司。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Prince of Qi Baoyu, Grand General Who Conquers on Horseback and Opener of the Office, was made Bearer of the Triple Staff.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Baoyu, prince of Qi, grand general who conquers on horseback and opener of the office, was made bearer of the triple staff.

sentences.zh: 北討都督河間王琛、長孫稚失利奔還，詔免琛、稚官爵。

translations.literal: Northern campaign commanders Prince of Hejian Chen and Changsun Zhi were defeated and fled back; an edict removed Chen and Zhi from office and rank.
translations.idiomatic: Northern campaign commanders Chen, prince of Hejian, and Changsun Zhi were defeated and fled back; an edict removed Chen and Zhi from office and rank.

sentences.zh: 庫莫奚國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: The state of Kumo Xi sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The state of Kumo Xi sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 五月丁未，車駕將北討，內外戒嚴。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingwei: the imperial carriage was about to campaign north; within and without were placed on alert.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingwei day, the imperial carriage was about to campaign north; within and without were placed on alert.

sentences.zh: 前給事黃門侍郎元略自蕭衍還朝，封義陽王。

translations.literal: Former attendant gentleman of the yellow gate Yuan Lue returned from Xiao Yan and was enfeoffed as Prince of Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: Former attendant gentleman of the yellow gate Yuan Lue returned from Xiao Yan and was enfeoffed as prince of Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 以丞相、高陽王雍為大司馬；

translations.literal: Chancellor and Prince of Gaoyang Yong was made Grand Marshal;
translations.idiomatic: Yong, chancellor and prince of Gaoyang, was made grand marshal;

sentences.zh: 吏部尚書、廣陽王淵為驃騎大將軍、儀同三司，尋為大都督，率都督章武王融北討脩禮。

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel and Prince of Guangyang Yuan was made Grand General Who Conquers on Horseback and Bearer of the Triple Staff, and soon grand commander, leading Commander and Prince of Zhangwu Rong on the northern campaign against Xiuli.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan, minister of personnel and prince of Guangyang, was made grand general who conquers on horseback and bearer of the triple staff, and soon grand commander, leading Rong, commander and prince of Zhangwu, on the northern campaign against Xiuli.

sentences.zh: 戊申，燕州刺史崔秉率眾棄城南走中山。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Inspector of Yan Province Cui Bing led troops, abandoned the city, and fled south to Zhongshan.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Cui Bing, inspector of Yan Province, led troops, abandoned the city, and fled south to Zhongshan.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以安西將軍、光祿大夫、宗正珍孫為都督，討汾州反胡。

translations.literal: Day yichou: General Who Pacifies the West and Household Minister Zhen Sun was made commander to attack the rebel Hu of Fen Province.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Zhen Sun, general who pacifies the west and household minister, was made commander to attack the rebel Hu of Fen Province.

sentences.zh: 六月己巳，曲赦齊州。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jisi: a partial amnesty for Qi Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jisi day, a partial amnesty was proclaimed for Qi Province.

sentences.zh: 絳蜀陳雙熾聚眾反，自號始建王。

translations.literal: Chen Shuangchi of Jiangshu gathered a crowd and rebelled, styling himself King of Shijian.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Shuangchi of Jiangshu gathered a crowd and rebelled, styling himself King of Shijian.

sentences.zh: 曲赦平陽、建興、正平三郡。

translations.literal: A partial amnesty for the three commanderies of Pingyang, Jianxing, and Zhengping.
translations.idiomatic: A partial amnesty was proclaimed for the three commanderies of Pingyang, Jianxing, and Zhengping.

sentences.zh: 詔假鎮西將軍、都督長孫稚討雙熾，平之。

translations.literal: An edict made acting General Who Pacifies the West and Commander Changsun Zhi attack Shuangchi and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Zhi, acting general who pacifies the west and commander, attack Shuangchi and pacify them.

sentences.zh: 丙子，義陽王略改封東平王。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Prince of Yiyang Lue was changed to Prince of Dongping.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Lue, prince of Yiyang, was changed to prince of Dongping.

sentences.zh: 衞大將軍、西道都督元恒芝為車騎大將軍、儀同三司。

translations.literal: Grand General of the Guard and Western Route Commander Yuan Hengzhi was made General of Chariots and Cavalry and Bearer of the Triple Staff.
translations.idiomatic: Hengzhi, grand general of the guard and western route commander, was made general of chariots and cavalry and bearer of the triple staff.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔復京兆王繼本封江陽王。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: an edict restored Prince of Jingzhao Ji to his original fief as Prince of Jiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day an edict restored Ji, prince of Jingzhao, to his original fief as prince of Jiangyang.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔曰：「自運屬艱棘，歷載於茲，烽驛交馳，旌鼓不息，祖宗盛業，危若綴旒，社稷鴻基，殆將淪墜。

translations.literal: Day wuzi, an edict stated: "Since fortune turned harsh, years have piled up here; beacons and posts race in relay and banners and drums never cease—the ancestors' great enterprise hangs by a thread, the altars' foundation nearly falls.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day an edict stated: "Since fortune turned harsh, years have piled up here; beacons and posts race in relay and banners and drums never cease—the ancestors' great enterprise hangs by a thread, the altars' foundation nearly falls.

sentences.zh: 朕威德不能遐被，經略無以及遠，俾令蒼生罹此塗炭，何以苟安黃屋，無愧黔黎。

translations.literal: My majesty cannot reach far; strategy cannot extend afar—how can I rest easy in the yellow canopy and face the black-haired people without shame?
translations.idiomatic: My majesty cannot reach far; strategy cannot extend afar—how can I rest easy in the yellow canopy and face the black-haired people without shame?

sentences.zh: 今便避居正殿，蔬餐素服。

translations.literal: Now I withdraw to the main hall and take plain food and simple dress.
translations.idiomatic: Now I withdraw to the main hall and take plain food and simple dress.

sentences.zh: 當親自招募，收集忠勇。

translations.literal: I shall personally recruit and gather the loyal and brave.
translations.idiomatic: I shall personally recruit and gather the loyal and brave.

sentences.zh: 其有直言正諫之士，敢決徇義之夫，二十五日悉集華林東門，人別引見，共論得失。

translations.literal: Those who speak straight and remonstrate, men daring to die for righteousness—on the twenty-fifth day all shall assemble at the east gate of Hualin; each will be received separately to discuss gains and losses together.
translations.idiomatic: Those who speak straight and remonstrate, men daring to die for righteousness—on the twenty-fifth day all shall assemble at the east gate of Hualin; each will be received separately to discuss gains and losses together.

sentences.zh: 班告內外，咸使聞知。

translations.literal: Proclaim within and without so all may hear."
translations.idiomatic: Proclaim within and without so all may hear."

sentences.zh: 」乙未，以衞將軍、東平王略為左光祿大夫、儀同三司。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Prince of Dongping Lue was made Left Grand Master of Splendid Carriages and Bearer of the Triple Staff.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Lue, prince of Dongping, was made left grand master of splendid carriages and bearer of the triple staff.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙午，杜洛周遣其別帥曹紇真寇掠幽州。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day bingwu: Du Luozhou sent his separate commander Cao Hezhen to raid You Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingwu day, Du Luozhou sent his separate commander Cao Hezhen to raid You Province.

sentences.zh: 行臺常景遣都督于榮邀于粟園，[14]大破之，斬紇真，獲三十餘級，牛驢二萬餘頭。

translations.literal: Chang Jing of the mobile office sent Commander Yu Rong to intercept them at Su Garden, [14] greatly defeated them, beheaded Hezhen, and took more than thirty heads and more than twenty thousand oxen and donkeys.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Jing of the mobile office sent Commander Yu Rong to intercept them at Su Garden, [14] greatly defeated them, beheaded Hezhen, and took more than thirty heads and more than twenty thousand oxen and donkeys.

sentences.zh: 戊申，恒州陷，行臺元纂奔冀州。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Heng Province fell; Yuan Zuan of the mobile office fled to Ji Province.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Heng Province fell; Yuan Zuan of the mobile office fled to Ji Province.

sentences.zh: 甲子，蕭衍將元樹、湛僧珍等寇壽春。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Xiao Yan's generals Yuan Shu, Zhan Sengzhen, and others raided Shouchun.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Xiao Yan's generals Yuan Shu, Zhan Sengzhen, and others raided Shouchun.

sentences.zh: 八月丙子，進封廣川縣開國公元巶為常山王。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingzi: Yuan Yan, state-founding Duke of Guangchuan, was advanced to Prince of Changshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingzi day, Yuan Yan, state-founding duke of Guangchuan, was advanced to prince of Changshan.

sentences.zh: [15]以驃騎大將軍、東道行臺、臨淮王彧為儀同三司。

translations.literal: [15] Prince of Huaiyang Yu, Grand General Who Conquers on Horseback and Eastern Route Mobile Office commander, was made Bearer of the Triple Staff.
translations.idiomatic: [15] Yu, prince of Huaiyang, grand general who conquers on horseback and eastern route mobile office commander, was made bearer of the triple staff.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，帝幸南石窟寺，即日還宮。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: the emperor visited the Southern Stone Grotto Temple and returned to the palace the same day.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the emperor visited the Southern Stone Grotto Temple and returned to the palace the same day.

sentences.zh: 戊子，進散騎常侍、御史中尉、武城縣開國公子攸為長樂王。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Ziyou, scattered cavalier attendant, censor-in-chief, and state-founding Duke of Wucheng, was advanced to Prince of Changle.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Ziyou, scattered cavalier attendant, censor-in-chief, and state-founding duke of Wucheng, was advanced to prince of Changle.

sentences.zh: 都督伊瓫生討巴，失利戰歿。

translations.literal: Commander Yi Longsheng attacked Ba, was defeated, and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Yi Longsheng attacked Ba, was defeated, and died in battle.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，賊帥元洪業斬鮮于脩禮，請降，為賊黨葛榮所殺。

translations.literal: Day guisi: the bandit chief Yuan Hongye beheaded Xianyu Xiuli and offered surrender; he was killed by the bandit faction of Ge Rong.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day the bandit chief Yuan Hongye beheaded Xianyu Xiuli and offered surrender; he was killed by the bandit faction of Ge Rong.

sentences.zh: 都督尒朱榮於肆州執刺史尉慶賓，令其從叔羽生統州事。

translations.literal: Commander Erzhu Rong at Si Province seized Inspector Wei Qingbin and had his younger uncle Yusheng administer the province.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Erzhu Rong at Si Province seized Inspector Wei Qingbin and had his younger uncle Yusheng administer the province.

sentences.zh: 九月辛亥，葛榮敗都督廣陽王淵、章武王融於博野白牛邏，融歿於陣。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinhai: Ge Rong defeated Commander Prince of Guangyang Yuan and Prince of Zhangwu Rong at Bolu White Oxen Camp; Rong died in the battle line.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinhai day, Ge Rong defeated Yuan, commander and prince of Guangyang, and Rong, prince of Zhangwu, at Bolu White Oxen Camp; Rong died in the battle line.

sentences.zh: 榮自稱天子，號曰齊國，年稱廣安。

translations.literal: Rong styled himself Son of Heaven, state name Qi, era name Guang'an.
translations.idiomatic: Rong styled himself Son of Heaven, state name Qi, era name Guang'an.

sentences.zh: 甲申，常景又破洛周，斬其武川王賀拔文興、別帥侯莫陳升，生擒男女四百口，牛驢五千餘頭。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Chang Jing again defeated Luozhou, beheaded his Prince of Wuchuan Hebawenxing and separate commander Houmochen Sheng, and captured alive four hundred men and women and more than five thousand oxen and donkeys.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Chang Jing again defeated Luozhou, beheaded his Prince of Wuchuan Hebawenxing and separate commander Houmochen Sheng, and captured alive four hundred men and women and more than five thousand oxen and donkeys.

sentences.zh: 就德興攻陷平州，殺刺史王買奴。

translations.literal: Jiudexing took Ping Province and killed Inspector Wang Mainu.
translations.idiomatic: Jiudexing took Ping Province and killed Inspector Wang Mainu.

sentences.zh: 是月，莫折天生請降，蕭寶夤使行臺左丞崔士和入據秦州。

translations.literal: That month: Moqi Tiansheng offered surrender; Xiao Baoyu sent Left Assistant of the Mobile Office Cui Shihe to enter and hold Qin Province.
translations.idiomatic: That month Moqi Tiansheng offered surrender; Baoyu sent Cui Shihe, left assistant of the mobile office, to enter and hold Qin Province.

sentences.zh: 天生復叛，送士和於胡琛，殺之。

translations.literal: Tiansheng rebelled again, sent Shihe to Hu Chen, and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Tiansheng rebelled again, sent Shihe to Hu Chen, and killed him.

sentences.zh: 冬十有一月戊戌，杜洛周攻陷幽州，執刺史王延年及行臺常景。

translations.literal: Eleventh month of winter, day wuxu: Du Luozhou took You Province, seized Inspector Wang Yannian and Chang Jing of the mobile office.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on wuxu day, Du Luozhou took You Province, seized Wang Yannian, inspector, and Chang Jing of the mobile office.

sentences.zh: 丙午，稅京師田租，畝五升；

translations.literal: Day bingwu: field tax in the capital was levied at five sheng per mu;
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day field tax in the capital was levied at five sheng per mu;

sentences.zh: 借賃公田者，畝一斗。

translations.literal: those borrowing public fields paid one dou per mu.
translations.idiomatic: those borrowing public fields paid one dou per mu.

sentences.zh: [16]閏月，稅市人出入者各一錢，店舍為五等。

translations.literal: [16] Intercalary month: those entering or leaving the market paid one coin each; shops and lodgings were graded in five classes.
translations.idiomatic: [16] In the intercalary month those entering or leaving the market paid one coin each; shops and lodgings were graded in five classes.

sentences.zh: 齊州平原民劉樹、劉蒼生聚眾反，州軍破走之，劉樹奔蕭衍。

translations.literal: The people of Pingyuan in Qi Province, Liu Shu and Liu Cangsheng, gathered a crowd and rebelled; provincial troops routed them; Liu Shu fled to Xiao Yan.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Pingyuan in Qi Province, Liu Shu and Liu Cangsheng, gathered a crowd and rebelled; provincial troops routed them; Liu Shu fled to Xiao Yan.

sentences.zh: 衍將元樹逼壽春，[17]揚州刺史李憲力屈，以城降之。

translations.literal: Yan's general Yuan Shu pressed Shouchun; [17] Inspector Li Xian was overcome and surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Yan's general Yuan Shu pressed Shouchun; [17] Li Xian, inspector, was overcome and surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 初留州、郡、縣及長史、司馬、戍主副質子於京師。

translations.literal: At first hostages of provinces, commanderies, counties, chief clerks, administrators, and garrison chiefs and deputies had been detained in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: At first hostages of provinces, commanderies, counties, chief clerks, administrators, and garrison chiefs and deputies had been detained in the capital.

sentences.zh: 衍又遣將攻逼新野，詔都督魏承祖討之。

translations.literal: Yan again sent generals to press Xinye; an edict ordered Commander Wei Chengzu to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: Yan again sent generals to press Xinye; an edict ordered Wei Chengzu, commander, to attack them.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「頃舊京淪覆，中原喪亂，宗室子女，屬籍在七廟之內，為雜戶濫門所拘辱者，悉聽離絕。」

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Lately the old capital fell and the central plain was lost in disorder; imperial clan sons and daughters registered within the seven temples who were detained and shamed by mixed households and illicit gates may all sever those ties."
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "Lately the old capital fell and the central plain was lost in disorder; imperial clan sons and daughters registered within the seven temples who were detained and shamed by mixed households and illicit gates may all sever those ties."

sentences.zh: 三年春正月甲戌，以司空公皇甫度為司徒，儀同三司蕭寶夤為司空，車騎將軍北海王顥為車騎大將軍、儀同三司。

translations.literal: Third year, spring, first month, day jiaxu: Huangfu Du, Duke of Minister of Works, was made Minister over the Masses; Bearer of the Triple Staff Xiao Baoyu was made Minister of Works; General of Chariots and Cavalry and Prince of Beihai Yan was made Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry and Bearer of the Triple Staff.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, spring, first month, on jiaxu day, Huangfu Du, duke of minister of works, was made minister over the masses; Baoyu, bearer of the triple staff, was made minister of works; Yan, general of chariots and cavalry and prince of Beihai, was made grand general of chariots and cavalry and bearer of the triple staff.

sentences.zh: 徐州民任道棱聚眾反，襲據蕭城以叛。

translations.literal: The people of Xuzhou, Ren Daoling, gathered a crowd and rebelled, seized and held Xiaocheng in revolt.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Xuzhou, Ren Daoling, gathered a crowd and rebelled, seized and held Xiaocheng in revolt.

sentences.zh: 州軍討平之。

translations.literal: Provincial troops suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial troops suppressed and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，葛榮陷殷州，刺史崔楷固節死之，遂東圍冀州。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Ge Rong took Yin Province; Inspector Cui Kai held firm to integrity and died; he then besieged Ji Province from the east.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Ge Rong took Yin Province; Cui Kai, inspector, held firm to integrity and died; he then besieged Ji Province from the east.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔峻鑄錢之制。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: an edict tightened the system for casting coin.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day an edict tightened the system for casting coin.

sentences.zh: 蕭寶夤、元恒芝大敗于涇州，大隴都督、南平王仲冏，小隴都督高聿並相尋退散，東秦州刺史潘義淵以汧城降賊。

translations.literal: Xiao Baoyu and Yuan Hengzhi were greatly defeated at Jing Province; Grand Commander of Great Long, Prince of Nanping Zhongtong, and Commander of Little Long Gao Yu both withdrew in succession; Pan Yiyuan, inspector of East Qin, surrendered Qian city to the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Baoyu and Hengzhi were greatly defeated at Jing Province; Zhongtong, grand commander of great Long and prince of Nanping, and Gao Yu, commander of little Long, both withdrew in succession; Pan Yiyuan, inspector of East Qin, surrendered Qian city to the bandits.

sentences.zh: 高平虜賊逼岐州，城人執刺史魏蘭根，以城應之。

translations.literal: The barbarian bandits of Gaoping pressed Qi Province; the townspeople seized Inspector Wei Langen and joined the city to them.
translations.idiomatic: The barbarian bandits of Gaoping pressed Qi Province; the townspeople seized Wei Langen, inspector, and joined the city to them.

sentences.zh: 豳州刺史畢祖暉、行臺羊深並奔退，祖暉於陣歿。

translations.literal: Inspector Bi Zuhui and Chang Shen of the mobile office both fled; Zuhui died in the battle line.
translations.idiomatic: Zuhui, inspector, and Shen, mobile office director, both fled; Zuhui died in the battle line.

sentences.zh: 北海王顥尋亦敗走。

translations.literal: Prince of Beihai Yan likewise was defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Yan, prince of Beihai, likewise was defeated and fled.

sentences.zh: 賊帥胡引祖據北華州以應之。

translations.literal: The bandit chief Hu Yinzu held North Hua Province in response.
translations.idiomatic: The bandit chief Hu Yinzu held North Hua Province in response.

sentences.zh: 賊帥叱干騏麟入據豳州。

translations.literal: The bandit chief Chigan Qilin entered and held Bin Province.
translations.idiomatic: The bandit chief Chigan Qilin entered and held Bin Province.

sentences.zh: [18]曲赦關西及正平、平陽、建興。

translations.literal: [18] A partial amnesty for Guanxi and Zhengping, Pingyang, and Jianxing.
translations.idiomatic: [18] A partial amnesty was proclaimed for Guanxi and Zhengping, Pingyang, and Jianxing.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以司徒皇甫度為太尉。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Huangfu Du, Minister of Works, was made Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Huangfu Du, minister of works, was made grand commandant.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以四方未平，詔內外戒嚴，將親出討。

translations.literal: Day jichou: because the four quarters were not pacified, an edict placed within and without on alert; the emperor was about to campaign in person.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day because the four quarters were not pacified, an edict placed within and without on alert; the emperor was about to campaign in person.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，蕭衍將湛僧珍圍東豫州，[19]詔散騎常侍元暐為都督以討之。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Xiao Yan's general Zhan Sengzhen besieged East Yi Province; [19] an edict made Yuan Wei, scattered cavalier attendant, commander to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Zhan Sengzhen, Xiao Yan's general, besieged East Yi Province; [19] an edict made Yuan Wei, scattered cavalier attendant, commander to attack them.

sentences.zh: 是月，衍又遣將彭羣、王辯等率眾數萬逼琅邪，詔青州、南青二州討之。

translations.literal: That month: Yan again sent generals Peng Qun, Wang Bian, and others with tens of thousands to press Langye; an edict ordered Qing and South Qing provinces to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yan again sent generals Peng Qun, Wang Bian, and others with tens of thousands to press Langye; an edict ordered Qing and South Qing provinces to attack them.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉，詔曰：「關隴遭罹寇難，燕趙賊逆憑陵，蒼生波流，耕農靡業，加諸轉運，勞役已甚，州倉儲實，無宜懸匱，自非開輸賞之格，何以息漕運之煩。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingyou, an edict stated: "Guan and Long have suffered raider calamity; Yan and Zhao are overrun by bandit rebels; the common people drift on the waves and farming has no livelihood. Added transport and corvée labor are already heavy; provincial granaries should not hang empty—unless a standard is opened for delivering grain as reward, how can the trouble of canal transport be stilled?
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dingyou day, an edict stated: "Guan and Long have suffered raider calamity; Yan and Zhao are overrun by bandit rebels; the common people drift on the waves and farming has no livelihood. Added transport and corvée labor are already heavy; provincial granaries should not hang empty—unless a standard is opened for delivering grain as reward, how can the trouble of canal transport be stilled?

sentences.zh: 凡有能輸粟入瀛、定、岐、雍四州者，官斗二百斛賞一階；

translations.literal: All who can deliver grain into the four provinces of Ying, Ding, Qi, and Yong receive one grade of office for every two hundred hu by official measure;
translations.idiomatic: All who can deliver grain into the four provinces of Ying, Ding, Qi, and Yong receive one grade of office for every two hundred hu by official measure;

sentences.zh: 入二華州者，五百石賞一階。

translations.literal: into the two Hua provinces, one grade for five hundred shi.
translations.idiomatic: into the two Hua provinces, one grade for five hundred shi.

sentences.zh: 不限多少，粟畢授官。

translations.literal: There is no limit on amount; when the grain is delivered, office is granted."
translations.idiomatic: There is no limit on amount; when the grain is delivered, office is granted."

sentences.zh: 」虜賊據潼關。

translations.literal: The barbarian bandits held Tong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: The barbarian bandits held Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 丁未，追復故東平王匡爵，改封濟南王。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: the deceased Prince of Dongping Kuang's rank was posthumously restored and changed to Prince of Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the deceased Kuang's rank was posthumously restored and changed to prince of Jinan.

sentences.zh: 庚申，東郡民趙顯德反，殺太守裴烟，自號都督，立其兄子為太守，詔都督李叔仁討之。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: the people of Dong commandery, Zhao Xiande, rebelled, killed Administrator Pei Yan, styled himself commander, installed his brother's son as administrator; an edict ordered Commander Li Shuren to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day the people of Dong commandery, Zhao Xiande, rebelled, killed Pei Yan, administrator, styled himself commander, installed his brother's son as administrator; an edict ordered Li Shuren, commander, to attack them.

sentences.zh: 是月，蕭衍將成景雋寇彭城，詔員外常侍崔孝芬為行臺，率將擊走之。

translations.literal: That month: Xiao Yan's general Cheng Jingjun raided Pengcheng; an edict made Yuanwai Changshi Cui Xiaofen mobile office commander to lead generals and drive them off.
translations.idiomatic: That month Cheng Jingjun, Xiao Yan's general, raided Pengcheng; an edict made Cui Xiaofen, yuanwai changshi, mobile office commander to lead generals and drive them off.

sentences.zh: 三月甲子，詔將西討，中外戒嚴。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiazi: an edict ordered a western campaign; within and without were placed on alert.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiazi day, an edict ordered a western campaign; within and without were placed on alert.

sentences.zh: 虜賊走，復潼關。

translations.literal: The barbarian bandits fled; Tong Pass was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: The barbarian bandits fled; Tong Pass was recovered.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔將回駕北討，詔金紫光祿大夫源子邕為大都督，討葛榮。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: an edict ordered the return of the carriage for a northern campaign; an edict made Yuan Ziyou, grand master of splendid carriages with golden seal and purple cord, grand commander to attack Ge Rong.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day an edict ordered the return of the carriage for a northern campaign; an edict made Yuan Ziyou, grand master of splendid carriages with golden seal and purple cord, grand commander to attack Ge Rong.

sentences.zh: 辛未，齊州廣川民劉鈞執清河太守邵懷，聚眾反，自署大行臺。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: the people of Guangchuan in Qi Province, Liu Jun, seized Qinghe Administrator Shao Huai, gathered a crowd and rebelled, and styled himself Grand Mobile Office.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the people of Guangchuan in Qi Province, Liu Jun, seized Shao Huai, Qinghe administrator, gathered a crowd and rebelled, and styled himself grand mobile office.

sentences.zh: 清河民房須自署大都督，[20]屯據昌國城。

translations.literal: The people of Qinghe, Fang Xu, styled himself grand commander [20] and camped at Changguo city.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Qinghe, Fang Xu, styled himself grand commander [20] and camped at Changguo city.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，別將元斌之討東郡，斬顯德。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer: separate commander Yuan Binzhi attacked Dong commandery and beheaded Xiande.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer separate commander Yuan Binzhi attacked Dong commandery and beheaded Xiande.

sentences.zh: 己酉，蠕蠕國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月，蠕蠕國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Sixth month: the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔都督李叔仁討劉鈞，平之。

translations.literal: That month: an edict ordered Commander Li Shuren to attack Liu Jun and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: That month an edict ordered Li Shuren, commander, to attack Liu Jun and pacify them.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，陳郡民劉獲、鄭辯反於西華，號年天授，州軍討平之。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn: the people of Chen commandery, Liu Huo and Zheng Bian, rebelled at Xihua, styled their era Tian shou; provincial troops suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn the people of Chen commandery, Liu Huo and Zheng Bian, rebelled at Xihua, styled their era Tian shou; provincial troops suppressed and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 相州刺史、安樂王鑒據州反。

translations.literal: Inspector of Xiang Province and Prince of Anle Jian held the province in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Jian, inspector of Xiang Province and prince of Anle, held the province in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 己丑，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Day jichou: a general amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 是月，青州刺史、彭城王劭，南青州刺史胡平，遣將斬蕭衍將彭羣首，俘獲二千餘人。

translations.literal: That month: Liu Shao, inspector of Qing Province and Prince of Pengcheng, and Hu Ping, inspector of South Qing, sent generals to behead the head of Xiao Yan's general Peng Qun and capture more than two thousand.
translations.idiomatic: That month Liu Shao, inspector of Qing Province and prince of Pengcheng, and Hu Ping, inspector of South Qing, sent generals to behead the head of Peng Qun, Xiao Yan's general, and capture more than two thousand.

sentences.zh: 八月，都督源子邕、李軌、裴衍攻鄴。

translations.literal: Eighth month: commanders Yuan Ziyou, Li Gui, and Pei Yan attacked Ye.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month commanders Yuan Ziyou, Li Gui, and Pei Yan attacked Ye.

sentences.zh: 丁未，斬鑒，相州平。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Jian was beheaded; Xiang Province was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Jian was beheaded; Xiang Province was pacified.

sentences.zh: 仍令子邕等討葛榮。

translations.literal: They were then ordered to attack Ge Rong.
translations.idiomatic: They were then ordered to attack Ge Rong.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯，[21]東豫州刺史元慶和以城南叛。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinmao, [21] Yuan Qinghe, inspector of East Yi Province, rebelled with the south of the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinmao day, [21] Yuan Qinghe, inspector of East Yi Province, rebelled with the south of the city.

sentences.zh: 戊子，蠕蠕國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 秦州城民杜粲殺莫折念生，自行州事。

translations.literal: The townspeople of Qin Province killed Moqi Niansheng and acted as provincial governor themselves.
translations.idiomatic: The townspeople of Qin Province killed Moqi Niansheng and acted as provincial governor themselves.

sentences.zh: 南秦州城民辛琛自行州事，遣使歸罪。

translations.literal: The townspeople of South Qin Province, Xin Chen, acted as provincial governor themselves and sent envoys to confess guilt.
translations.idiomatic: The townspeople of South Qin Province, Xin Chen, acted as provincial governor themselves and sent envoys to confess guilt.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊申，曲赦恒農已西，河北、正平、平陽、邵郡及關西諸州。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day wushen: a partial amnesty west of Hengnong, Hebei, Zhengping, Pingyang, Shao commandery, and the provinces of Guanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wushen day, a partial amnesty was proclaimed west of Hengnong, Hebei, Zhengping, Pingyang, Shao commandery, and the provinces of Guanxi.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以衞將軍、討虜大都督尒朱榮為車騎將軍、儀同三司。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Erzhu Rong, general of the guard and grand commander who campaigns against barbarians, was made General of Chariots and Cavalry and Bearer of the Triple Staff.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Rong, general of the guard and grand commander who campaigns against barbarians, was made general of chariots and cavalry and bearer of the triple staff.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，雍州刺史蕭寶夤據州反，自號曰齊，年稱隆緒。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Xiao Baoyu, inspector of Yong Province, held the province in rebellion, styled his state Qi, era name Longxu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Baoyu, inspector of Yong Province, held the province in rebellion, styled his state Qi, era name Longxu.

sentences.zh: 詔尚書右僕射長孫稚討之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Changsun Zhi to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Changsun Zhi, right vice director of the Masters of Writing, to attack them.

sentences.zh: 十有一月己丑，葛榮攻陷冀州，執刺史元孚，逐出居民，凍死者十六七。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jichou: Ge Rong took Ji Province, seized Inspector Yuan Fu, drove out the residents, and six or seven in ten froze to death.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jichou day, Ge Rong took Ji Province, seized Yuan Fu, inspector, drove out the residents, and six or seven in ten froze to death.

sentences.zh: 十有二月戊申，都督源子邕、裴衍與葛榮戰，敗於陽平東北漳水曲，並戰歿。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wushen: commanders Yuan Ziyou and Pei Yan fought Ge Rong, were defeated at the bend of the Zhang River northeast of Yangping, and both died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wushen day, commanders Yuan Ziyou and Pei Yan fought Ge Rong, were defeated at the bend of the Zhang River northeast of Yangping, and both died in battle.

sentences.zh: 是月，杜粲為駱超所殺，超遣使歸罪。

translations.literal: That month: Du Can was killed by Luo Chao; Chao sent envoys to confess guilt.
translations.idiomatic: That month Du Can was killed by Luo Chao; Chao sent envoys to confess guilt.

sentences.zh: 武泰元年春正月癸亥，以北海王顥為驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、相州刺史。

translations.literal: First year of Wutai, spring, first month, day guihai: Prince of Beihai Yan was made Grand General Who Conquers on Horseback, Opener of the Office, Bearer of the Triple Staff, and Inspector of Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Wutai, spring, first month, on guihai day, Yan, prince of Beihai, was made grand general who conquers on horseback, opener of the office, bearer of the triple staff, and inspector of Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，定州為杜洛周所陷，執刺史楊津。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Ding Province was taken by Du Luozhou; Inspector Yang Jin was seized.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Ding Province was taken by Du Luozhou; Yang Jin, inspector, was seized.

sentences.zh: 瀛州刺史元寧以城降於洛周。

translations.literal: Yuan Ning, inspector of Ying Province, surrendered the city to Luozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Ning, inspector of Ying Province, surrendered the city to Luozhou.

sentences.zh: 皇女生，祕言皇子。

translations.literal: An imperial daughter was born; it was secretly said to be a prince.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial daughter was born; it was secretly said to be a prince.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: a general amnesty; the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day a general amnesty was proclaimed; the era name was changed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，長孫稚平潼關。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Changsun Zhi pacified Tong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Changsun Zhi pacified Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，雍州城人侯終德相率攻寶夤，寶夤攜南陽公主及子，與百餘騎渡渭而走，雍州平。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: the townspeople of Yong Province, Hou Zhongde and others together attacked Baoyu; Baoyu took the Princess of Nanyang and her son and with a little more than a hundred horsemen crossed the Wei and fled; Yong Province was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the townspeople of Yong Province, Hou Zhongde and others together attacked Baoyu; Baoyu took the Princess of Nanyang and her son and with a little more than a hundred horsemen crossed the Wei and fled; Yong Province was pacified.

sentences.zh: 二月，以長孫稚為車騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、雍州刺史、兼尚書僕射、西道行臺。

translations.literal: Second month: Changsun Zhi was made General of Chariots and Cavalry, Opener of the Office, Bearer of the Triple Staff, Inspector of Yong Province, and also Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Western Route Mobile Office commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Changsun Zhi was made general of chariots and cavalry, opener of the office, bearer of the triple staff, inspector of Yong Province, and also right vice director of the Masters of Writing and western route mobile office commander.

sentences.zh: 群盜燒劫鞏縣以西，關口以東，公路澗以南。

translations.literal: Bandits burned and plundered west of Gong county, east of the passes, and south of Gonglu Ravine.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits burned and plundered west of Gong county, east of the passes, and south of Gonglu Ravine.

sentences.zh: 詔武衞將軍李神軌為都督，討平之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered General of the Martial Guard Li Shengui commander to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Li Shengui, general of the martial guard, commander, to suppress and pacify them.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，帝崩於顯陽殿，時年十九。

translations.literal: Day guichou: the emperor died at Xianyang Hall; he was nineteen.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the emperor died at Xianyang Hall; he was nineteen.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，皇子即位，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: the prince ascended the throne and proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the prince ascended the throne and proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.

translations.literal: The empress dowager's edict stated: "The imperial house has held the calendar and received the chart for nearly two hundred years; successive sage ancestors have borne the altars in peace.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager's edict stated: "The imperial house has held the calendar and received the chart for nearly two hundred years; successive sage ancestors have borne the altars in peace.

sentences.zh: 高祖以文思先天，世宗以下武經世，股肱惟良，元首穆穆。

translations.literal: Gaozu by literary thought preceded Heaven; Shizong by martial power governed the age—arms and legs were all worthy, the head was reverent and grave.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu by literary thought preceded Heaven; Shizong by martial power governed the age—arms and legs were all worthy, the head was reverent and grave.

sentences.zh: 及大行在御，重以寬仁，奉養率由，溫明恭順。

translations.literal: When the late emperor held the throne, he was again broad and humane; in nurture he followed the constant ways, warm, bright, respectful, and obedient.
translations.idiomatic: When the late emperor held the throne, he was again broad and humane; in nurture he followed the constant ways, warm, bright, respectful, and obedient.

sentences.zh: 朕以寡昧，親臨萬國，識謝塗山，德慚文母。

translations.literal: I, small and dim, personally face the ten thousand states; my knowledge falls short of Tushan; my virtue shames the mother of Wen.
translations.idiomatic: I, small and dim, personally face the ten thousand states; my knowledge falls short of Tushan; my virtue shames the mother of Wen.

sentences.zh: 屬妖逆遞興，四郊多故。

translations.literal: Bandit calamities arose in succession and the four marches had many affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Bandit calamities arose in succession and the four marches had many affairs.

sentences.zh: 實望穹靈降祐，麟趾眾繁。

translations.literal: I truly hoped the dome would lower protection and many heirs like unicorn toes would flourish.
translations.idiomatic: I truly hoped the dome would lower protection and many heirs like unicorn toes would flourish.

sentences.zh: 自潘充華有孕椒宮，冀誕儲兩，而熊羆無兆，維虺遂彰。

translations.literal: When Lady Pan of the Flowery Palace became pregnant in the pepper palace, I hoped for an heir; yet the bear showed no sign and the great viper was revealed.
translations.idiomatic: When Lady Pan of the Flowery Palace became pregnant in the pepper palace, I hoped for an heir; yet the bear showed no sign and the great viper was revealed.

sentences.zh: 于時直以國步未康，假稱統胤，欲以底定物情，係仰宸極。

translations.literal: At the time, because the realm was not yet at peace, I falsely called it the imperial heir, wishing thereby to settle men's hearts and bind them to the apex.
translations.idiomatic: At the time, because the realm was not yet at peace, I falsely called it the imperial heir, wishing thereby to settle men's hearts and bind them to the apex.

sentences.zh: 何圖一旦，弓劍莫追，國道中微，大行絕祀。

translations.literal: Who could have thought that in a single morning bow and sword could not be followed—the way of the state declined mid-course and the great line was cut off.
translations.idiomatic: Who could have thought that in a single morning bow and sword could not be followed—the way of the state declined mid-course and the great line was cut off.

sentences.zh: 皇曾孫故臨洮王寶暉世子釗，體自高祖，天表卓異，大行平日養愛特深，義齊若子，事符當璧。

translations.literal: The late emperor's great-grandson, heir of the former Prince of Lintao Baohui, Zhao, by body descends from Gaozu; his heavenly countenance is outstanding; the late emperor in his daily life nourished and loved him especially, his righteousness equal to a son, his matter fitting the jade disk.
translations.idiomatic: The late emperor's great-grandson, heir of the former Prince of Lintao Baohui, Zhao, by body descends from Gaozu; his heavenly countenance is outstanding; the late emperor in his daily life nourished and loved him especially, his righteousness equal to a son, his matter fitting the jade disk.

sentences.zh: 及翊日弗愈，大漸彌留，乃延入青蒲，受命玉几。

translations.literal: When the next day he did not improve, his decline grew severe and lingering; then he was brought into the Green Rush Hall to receive the mandate at the jade armrest.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he grew no better; as his decline deepened he was brought into the Green Rush Hall to receive the mandate at the jade armrest.

sentences.zh: 暨陳衣在庭，登策靡及，允膺大寶，即日踐阼。

translations.literal: When mourning garments were displayed in the court, before the testament could be reached he ascended; he truly received the great treasure, and that very day took the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Mourning garments were already displayed in the court; before the testament could be read he had ascended—he received the great treasure and that very day took the throne.

sentences.zh: 朕是用惶懼忸怩，心焉靡洎。

translations.literal: We therefore are fearful and ashamed; our heart finds no peace.
translations.idiomatic: We are seized with fear and shame; our heart cannot find rest.

sentences.zh: 今喪君有君，宗祏惟固，宜崇賞卿士，爰及百辟，凡厥在位，並加陟叙。

translations.literal: Now though we have lost a ruler we have a ruler; the ancestral temple alone is secure. It is fitting to exalt and reward ministers, reaching to the hundred officials—all those in office shall together receive promotion.
translations.idiomatic: Though we have lost a ruler, we have a ruler still; the ancestral temple stands secure. Ministers and the hundred officials alike—all who hold office—should be raised and rewarded.

sentences.zh: 內外百官文武、督將征人，遭艱解府，普加軍功二階；

translations.literal: Civil and military officials within and without, supervising generals and campaign troops who were dismissed from office because of the crisis—all shall receive two grades of military merit;
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials at court and in the provinces, supervising generals, and troops on campaign who were dismissed during the crisis shall all receive two grades of military merit;

translations.literal: for palace-guard military officers from Guardian of the Gate downward and personal attendants from Companion upward, and for commanders, three grades of military merit may be granted;
translations.idiomatic: palace-guard officers from Guardian of the Gate down and personal attendants from Companion up, together with field commanders, may receive three grades;

translations.idiomatic: those who lost office or rank may have their titles restored.

translations.idiomatic: Those stripped for treason or great rebellion are excluded.

sentences.zh: 清議禁錮，亦悉蠲除。

translations.literal: Pure-critique bans and prohibitions are also entirely remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Pure-critique bans and prohibitions are also entirely lifted.

translations.idiomatic: If holders of second rank and above cannot accept the grant themselves, they may pass it to a younger brother.

translations.idiomatic: Let this be proclaimed far and near so that all may know.

translations.idiomatic: " On yimao the young lord ascended the throne.

translations.idiomatic: That month Du Luozhou was absorbed by Ge Rong.

translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the guimao day, Ge Rong took Cangzhou and seized Inspector Xue Qingzhi; eight or nine residents in ten perished.

translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the posthumous title Emperor Xiaoming was elevated; on yiyou he was buried at Ding Mausoleum with temple name Suzong.

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, xuxu day: Erzhu Rong crossed the river.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on the xuxu day, Erzhu Rong crossed the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 庚子，皇太后、幼主崩。

translations.literal: On gengzi the Empress Dowager and the young lord died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the Empress Dowager and the young lord died.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：魏自宣武已後，政綱不張。

translations.literal: The historian says: From Emperor Xuanwu onward in Wei, the governing net was not drawn taut.
translations.idiomatic: The historian writes: From Emperor Xuanwu onward the Wei court no longer held the reins of government.

translations.literal: Then trouble rose on four sides, calamity spread to the capital region, and in the end his reign was not long.
translations.idiomatic: Trouble rose on every side; disaster reached the capital; in the end his reign was brief.

translations.literal: This too was the beginning of ruin and loss—alas!
translations.idiomatic: This was the beginning of the kingdom's slide into ruin—alas!

translations.idiomatic: Hu's note: "Liyuan should lie within the bounds of Gu'an county in Fanyang; the chestnuts of Gu'an were famed throughout the realm."

translations.idiomatic: Comment: Shui jing zhu juan 21, Ru River section, also has a "Liyuan" at Xuanchi, a different place—but the note says: "The chestnuts there are small and cannot compare with the fruit of Gu'an."

translations.literal: Thus at the end of Wei, Gu'an was still famed for its chestnuts.
translations.idiomatic: Thus at the end of Wei, Gu'an was still famed for its chestnuts.

sentences.zh: 胡說不為無據。

translations.literal: Hu's explanation is not without grounds.
translations.idiomatic: Hu's explanation is not without grounds.

sentences.zh: 進封廣川縣開國公元巶為常山王 諸本「巶」作「邵」。

translations.literal: Advanced in enfeoffment Guangchuan county founding marquis Yuan Zhao to Prince of Changshan: in all editions "Zhao" is written "Shao."
translations.idiomatic: Advanced in enfeoffment Guangchuan county founding marquis Yuan Zhao to Prince of Changshan: in all editions "Zhao" is written "Shao."

translations.literal: Comment: the newly excavated epitaph of Prince Wengong of Changshan states: "The prince's taboo name Zhao, style Zikai"—the second son of Prince Qinghe Yi.
translations.idiomatic: Comment: the newly excavated epitaph of Prince Wengong of Changshan states: "The prince's taboo name Zhao, style Zikai"—the second son of Prince Qinghe Yi.

sentences.zh: 卷九四閹官劉思逸傳見「清河王息邵」，知魏書之「常山王邵」，即墓誌之「常山王巶」。

translations.literal: Juan 94 Biography of the Eunuch Liu Siyi mentions "Shao, son of Prince Qinghe"—thus the Wei shu's "Prince of Changshan Shao" in the annals is the "Prince of Changshan Zhao" of the epitaph.
translations.idiomatic: Juan 94 Biography of the Eunuch Liu Siyi mentions "Shao, son of Prince Qinghe"—thus the Wei shu's "Prince of Changshan Shao" in the annals is the "Prince of Changshan Zhao" of the epitaph.

sentences.zh: 「巶」字見集韵卷三宵韵下，即昭穆之「昭」。

translations.literal: The character "Zhao" appears in Jiyun juan 3 under the xiao rhyme—it is the "zhao" of zhaomu, bright and solemn.
translations.idiomatic: The character "Zhao" appears in Jiyun juan 3 under the xiao rhyme—it is the "zhao" of zhaomu, bright and solemn.

，並云魏遣「常山王元昭」等統兵救援，為梁所敗，亦即墓誌之「元巶」。

translations.literal: , and both state that Wei dispatched "Prince of Changshan Yuan Zhao" and others to command relief troops, and were defeated by Liang—that is, the "Yuan Zhao" of the epitaph.
translations.idiomatic: —both say Wei sent Prince of Changshan Yuan Zhao and others to lead relief troops and that Liang defeated them; this is the Yuan Zhao of the epitaph.

sentences.zh: 墓誌不載巶援渦陽事，當因戰敗而諱之。

translations.literal: The epitaph does not record Zhao's relief of Woyang—probably concealed because of defeat.
translations.idiomatic: The epitaph omits Zhao's relief of Woyang, likely because the campaign failed.

sentences.zh: 本卷則於梁攻渦陽一字不及，元巶領兵救援就也失載。

translations.literal: This juan does not mention Liang's attack on Woyang at all, and Zhao's leading troops to relieve it is also missing.
translations.idiomatic: This juan never mentions Liang's attack on Woyang, nor Zhao's march to relieve it.

sentences.zh: 當時「常山王」唯此一人，「邵」乃「巶」形近而訛，今據墓誌改。

translations.literal: At that time there was only this one "Prince of Changshan"; "Shao" is a corruption from similar forms to "Zhao"—now emended according to the epitaph.
translations.idiomatic: Only one Prince of Changshan existed then; "Shao" is a graphic corruption of "Zhao," emended here from the epitaph.

sentences.zh: 卷一０莊帝紀建義元年四月庚子、卷一二靜帝紀興和元年三月甲寅及上引劉思逸傳同訛，逕改，不再出校記。

translations.literal: The same corruption appears at juan 10 Annals of Emperor Zhuang, fourth month gengzi of the first year of Jianyi; juan 12 Annals of Emperor Jing, third month jiayin of the first year of Xinghe; and the Biography of Liu Siyi cited above—all are emended directly without separate collation notes.
translations.idiomatic: The same error appears in juan 10 (Annals of Emperor Zhuang, gengzi of Jianyi year 1), juan 12 (Annals of Emperor Jing, jiayin of Xinghe year 1), and the Biography of Liu Siyi cited above—all corrected in the text without separate notes.

translations.idiomatic: Emended from juan 21 (Biography of Prince of Beihai Hao) and juan 113 (Monograph on Offices and Clans, Chigan clan entry).

translations.literal: Yet the entry for seventh month jiazi in the second year of Xiaochang above, juan 98 Biography of Xiao Yan, and Beiqishu juan 19 Biography of Wang Huai all have "Zhan Sengzhen"; though his true name was "Sengzhi," northerners at the time called him "Sengzhen," or simply "Seng"—no change is made here.
